Title: Director of Business Technology
Description:
Liteline Corporation is a privately held Canadian commercial lighting manufacturer with more than 160 employees, selling across Canada and the United States. We are adding a Director of Business Technology to our leadership team, a senior, hands-on role with ownership of technology across the business.

The role has two halves. The first is the job every growing company needs: keep our technology running, secure and recoverable across roughly 130 computers, Microsoft 365, our server cluster and our network. The second is newer. Our own people, from the three Co-Presidents to staff in Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service, now build software tools with AI assistants. The Director of Business Technology will give that work a professional backbone: version control, permissions, backups and fast recovery.

This is an enabling role as much as a technical one. We want our people to keep building quickly. The person in this position will make sure what they build is safe, recoverable and well looked after, without slowing anyone down.

This is a build role. Liteline’s people are already creating their own tools with AI. We are looking for a leader who can keep the core IT environment solid, put the right platforms and guardrails under home-built software, and teach non-programmers to work safely.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Keep Things Running**

* Own day-to-day IT across the business: computers, email, servers, networking, security and backups.
* Run Microsoft 365, including sign-in, multi-factor authentication (MFA), user access and licensing.
* Look after our on-premises server cluster, storage and network infrastructure.
* Oversee security monitoring and incident response together with our security monitoring partner.
* Maintain tested backups and the ability to restore systems and data quickly.
* Lead the help desk and set the service standards the business is held to.

**Own the Platforms**

* Set up and run, hands-on, the platforms our home-built tools live on.
* Own Liteline’s company GitHub organization, where code is saved with full history, including structure, permissions, single sign-on (SSO) and branch protection.
* Administer hosted databases (Supabase / Postgres), including access control, backups and recovery.
* Manage website and application hosting (Netlify), including deployments, domains and environments.
* Maintain a clear inventory of the tools in use, who owns each one and where it runs.

**Govern and Teach**

* Decide what AI assistants can access and set sensible guardrails for company data and credentials.
* Set light, practical rules that protect the business without getting in the way of the people building.
* Decide which home-built tools are business-critical and what level of protection each one needs.
* Run and rehearse restores so that recovery is proven, not assumed.
* Teach staff who are not programmers to work safely, for example explaining version control to someone in purchasing.
* Run training, enablement and “lunch and learn” sessions across the business.

**Team and Partners**

* Lead two on-site IT staff.
* Manage our outside partners for managed services, security monitoring and backup.
* Own the technology budget, licensing and vendor relationships, and bring forward stronger options as the market moves.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are looking for a hands-on technology leader who is equally comfortable running core IT and building platforms that sit under modern, AI-assisted development.

The successful candidate will understand infrastructure, identity and security, and will also understand how software is built, saved, deployed and recovered. Just as importantly, you will be able to explain those ideas in plain language to people who have never written code and help them adopt habits that last.

**Strong candidates will bring:**

* Hands-on experience setting up or administering a GitHub organization, including SSO and branch protection.
* Experience running a Microsoft Power Platform Centre of Excellence, citizen-developer or low-code programme.
* Hands-on experience running Supabase, Postgres, Netlify, Vercel or similar platforms.
* Solid Microsoft 365, identity, MFA, endpoint and security fundamentals.
* A track record of training and enabling non-technical staff, such as “lunch and learn” or enablement programmes.
* Experience building a function or process from scratch at a growing company.
* Clear communication and sound judgment about when rules help and when they get in the way.

There is no single path to this role. You might be:

* An IT lead at a 100-to-500-person manufacturer or distributor who personally ran a Power Platform governance programme, a low-code programme or the company’s GitHub organization.
* A developer or DevOps engineer who moved into an IT management role at a small or mid-sized company.
* A solutions architect or senior consultant at a managed services provider (MSP) serving small and mid-sized businesses, ready to go in-house.
* The “first IT hire” at a startup who set up sign-in, devices and GitHub from scratch, then moved to a mid-sized company.
* Experience in mid-sized manufacturing, distribution or wholesale is helpful but not required.

**REPORTING AND WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**

This position reports to the VP of Operations.

You will work closely with Liteline’s three Co-Presidents, who are technically capable and build their own tools, and with Finance, Product Development, Engineering and Customer Service. You will be a partner to the people building, not a gatekeeper.

**LOCATION AND WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

This position is based at Liteline's Richmond Hill head office and is on-site five days per week with regular presence at our distribution facilities.

The successful candidate should expect to be highly engaged with the business and to spend real time understanding how departments and facilities actually operate.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is a rare chance to shape how an established Canadian manufacturer builds and runs its technology at a moment when AI is changing who can create software.

Liteline is privately held, decisions are made without layers of approval, and good ideas get backed. Our leaders build with technology themselves and value this work. The Director of Business Technology will define the platforms, guardrails and habits that let the whole company build with confidence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

Liteline offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental and life insurance following three months of service, and a group RRSP with partial company match.

**TO APPLY**

Qualified candidates are invited to apply directly through this posting.

*Liteline Corporation is an equal opportunity employer that values the unique skills and experiences of every candidate. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities throughout the recruitment and hiring process. To request accommodation, please contact Human Resources with the position title in the subject line.*

**Job Summary**

  
  

**Position Summary (Purpose of job):**

The Sr. Director (M5) leads major divisional functions or corporate sub‑functions, providing enterprise‑level strategic direction, long‑range planning, and operational leadership across multiple related disciplines. This role analyzes external business environments to anticipate trends, influence strategy, and recommend growth opportunities for the business unit. It directs second‑level managers and Directors, ensuring operational excellence, cross‑functional integration, and execution of high‑impact initiatives. The Sr. Director is financially accountable for operating plans, budgets, and forecasts, and manages complex organizational performance across services, programs, and customer outcomes.

As a senior enterprise advisor, the Sr. Director interfaces with VPs and executive leaders to shape integrated business strategies and ensure alignment of products, solutions, and capabilities with organizational priorities. The role leads talent pipelines, strengthens leadership benches, and manages significant conflicts and disciplinary matters. It drives continuous improvement, optimizes cross‑functional workflows, and ensures strategic communication across stakeholder groups. The Sr. Director represents the function internally and externally, advancing McKesson’s mission through innovation, strategic influence, and enterprise stewardship.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Direct development and execution of integrated business strategies, partnering with VPs and senior executives to shape enterprise outcomes.

* Lead strategic planning, prioritization, and delivery of large‑scale initiatives across multiple sub‑functions or locations.

* Establish functional standards, governance processes, and performance metrics to ensure value delivery and regulatory alignment.

* Oversee implementation of high‑impact technology, operational, and process improvements that enhance efficiency and customer satisfaction.

* Serve as primary advisor to senior leadership on modernization, automation, cloud, and transformation strategies.

* Manage divisional budgets, capital planning, cost‑reduction initiatives, investment decisions, and financial transparency efforts.

* Direct vendor strategy, contract negotiations, service‑level oversight, and lifecycle management across platforms.

* Lead long‑range workforce planning, organizational design, and leadership development programs.

* Drive cross‑functional change leadership, ensuring communication and adoption of major transformation initiatives.

* Provide thought leadership by assessing emerging trends, developing executive recommendations, and challenging conventional approaches.

**Minimum Job Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities):**

* Highly advanced knowledge of enterprise operations, strategic planning, and cross‑functional leadership across large, complex organizations.

* Expertise in governance frameworks, performance measurement, and enterprise risk and compliance programs.

* Ability to direct multi‑disciplinary teams and serve as a senior advisor on technology, architecture, product, or operational strategy.

* Advanced financial management skills, including budgeting, capital planning, cost optimization, and ROI analysis.

* Executive‑level communication and storytelling skills for influencing VPs, C‑suite leaders, and external partners.

* Strong capability to drive enterprise transformation, manage ambiguity, and resolve complex organizational conflicts.

* Demonstrated skill in talent strategy, succession planning, leadership development, and culture shaping.

* Expertise managing enterprise vendor ecosystems, partnerships, negotiations, and lifecycle governance.

* Behavioral proficiency at Sr. Director level: Change Advocate (Role Model), Customer & Business Driven (Role Model), Collaboration & Partnership (Role Model), Decision Making (Role Model), Influencing Others (Role Model), Innovative Thinking (Advanced), Oral & Written Communication (Role Model), Servant Leadership (Role Model).

* Strategic and analytical thinking for long‑term planning, trend analysis, and enterprise investment decisions.

**Business Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; typically 13+ years of professional experience with 6+ years of diversified leadership, planning, communication, and people‑management responsibilities.

* Experience directing complex operations across multiple sub‑functions or geographic locations, with accountability for large budgets and enterprise performance.

* Demonstrated success leading transformation programs, vendor portfolios, and cross‑functional enterprise initiatives.

* Proven ability to develop senior leaders, shape organizational strategy, and influence executive‑level decision‑making.

Title: Director, Application Support
Description:
The Director, Application Support leads application support and maintenance in a fast-paced retail environment, ensuring reliable services and alignment with business goals. The role oversees internal teams and managed service providers, IT service management, major incidents, stakeholder communications, budgets, and operational governance. Working across business and technology teams, the Director drives service quality, continuous improvement, and team development through strong leadership, technical expertise, and a customer-focused approach.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Own L1/L2/L3 application support for store systems, merchandising, supply chain/WMS, ERP, enterprise tools, eCommerce/OMS and integrations.
* Lead incident, major incident, problem, service request, change, and escalation management, including root cause analysis, executive communications, and prevention of recurring incidents.
* Manage application health and service levels; report availability, mean time to restore service (MTTR), ticket volume and aging, and SLA performance.
* Partner with Business Solutions, Development, Infrastructure, Security, Integration, and Store Operations on releases, deployments, and operational readiness throughout the application lifecycle.
* Support the VP of IT Operations in aligning IT strategy and business objectives through collaboration across business and technology teams.
* Strengthen application reliability through end-to-end observability, using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts to detect issues proactively, reduce alert noise, and accelerate diagnosis.
* Improve support efficiency through automation and knowledge management, including reusable runbooks, automated incident enrichment and routing, and controlled remediation to reduce repetitive tasks, manual effort, and recovery time.
* Manage budgets, operational governance, and application lifecycle and technical debt roadmaps.
* Build and develop high-performing teams.
* Oversee vendor and managed service providers.

**Skills:**

* Communicate clearly with technical, non-technical, and executive audiences, adapting messages to their needs.
* Apply ITIL or equivalent service management frameworks and define technical standards that meet SLA requirements.
* Proficiency with service management tools (e.g., ServiceNow), observability platforms, and automation technologies.
* Demonstrated experience supporting high-volume software environments.
* Manage third-party vendors and multiple functional areas within a managed services model.
* Lead, mentor, and develop application support teams, including performance management, team building, and conflict resolution.
* Adept at facilitating cross-team agreements.
* Work independently and effectively under pressure, solve problems, and quickly assess the business impact of technology issues.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience required.
* 8–15 years of IT experience, including 5+ years leading application support or operations teams, with experience managing managers, large support organizations, and application portfolios.
* Strong background in ITSM, ITIL, incident and problem management, and ServiceNow or similar tools.
* Experience managing vendors, managed services, and offshore support teams.
* Budget, contract, and operational governance experience.
* Retail experience with store and merchandising systems strongly preferred

Start Rate = $172,000 to $188,000 based on experience plus a 25% bonus and equity. The company offers Health, Dental, & Vision, a flexible spending account, life and disability insurance benefits, a 401k plan, PTO, paid holidays annually, and an employee stock purchase plan.

Title: Lead Director, Network Management (Florida)
Description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

***\*\*This candidate must reside in the state of Florida\*\****

**Position Summary**  
The Director, Provider Network Strategy and Contracting leads Aetna’s provider network strategy and contracting agenda for a geographic area of Florida “Market(s)”. This leader owns the market’s network performance, from the design and negotiation of strategic agreements with major health systems, physician organizations, and ancillary providers through to the delivery of measurable gains in affordability, access, and quality. The Director shapes the long-term direction of the network, serves as Aetna’s senior executive voice to the provider community, and leads a team of contract negotiators and network professionals. The role is accountable for market-level financial results and for aligning provider strategy with Aetna’s growth, product, and clinical priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Strategy and Leadership*

* Set and execute the multi-year network strategy for a Market across commercial, Medicare Advantage, and Medicaid lines of business, balancing cost, access, quality, and competitive positioning
* Lead, develop, and coach a team of network negotiators and contracting professionals, establishing clear performance objectives, negotiation standards, and accountability for results
* Serve as an enterprise thought partner to senior leadership on market dynamics, provider consolidation, and emerging risks and opportunities

*Negotiation and Provider Partnerships*

* Lead high-stakes negotiations with hospital systems, large physician groups, and independent physician associations, including fee-for-service, value-based, and risk-based arrangements
* Establish and sustain executive-level relationships with provider C-suite leaders, system presidents, and physician group principals to foster long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships
* Direct escalated contract disputes, reimbursement issues, and strategic provider conflicts to resolution, protecting both member access and Aetna’s financial interests

*Financial and Market Performance*

* Own market-level medical cost and affordability targets, using cost and utilization analytics, market intelligence, and competitive benchmarking to guide negotiation strategy and deal structure
* Partner with Finance and Actuarial to evaluate the financial impact of major agreements and ensure contract economics align with business objectives
* Oversee pipeline management, negotiation sequencing, and reporting of savings and performance results to senior leadership

*Value-Based Care and Quality*

* Advance the market’s transition to value-based and total cost of care arrangements, driving provider adoption and measurable improvements in quality and member outcomes
* Hold provider partners accountable to contract performance, directing corrective action, renegotiation, or network changes where warranted

*Cross-Functional Alignment and Compliance*

* Collaborate with Medical Management, Legal, Compliance, Provider Operations, Sales, and Product to align contract strategy with enterprise priorities and member needs
* Ensure network adequacy, access, and regulatory compliance across Florida requirements, CMS standards, and Aetna and CVS Health policies
* Maintain rigorous governance over contract documentation, approvals, and reporting

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of progressive experience in health care provider contracting, payer-provider negotiation, managed care, or a related field, including 3+ years in a people leadership role
* Demonstrated success leading complex, high-value negotiations with hospital systems and large physician organizations
* Deep expertise in provider reimbursement methodologies (DRG, per diem, fee schedules, capitation) and value-based and risk-based models
* Strong financial acumen, with the ability to evaluate complex financial models and translate claims and utilization data into negotiation strategy
* Proven executive presence, with exceptional negotiation, communication, and relationship management skills
* Track record of managing multiple concurrent negotiations and competing priorities in a fast-moving environment
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree (MBA, MHA, or MPH)
* Established relationships with leadership at major Florida health systems and independent physician associations
* In-depth knowledge of the Florida health care landscape, including market competitors, provider consolidation trends, and regulatory environment
* Experience with Medicare Advantage and Medicaid contracting
* Success driving value-based contracting and total cost of care strategies at scale

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree required/specialized training/relevant professional qualification.

$100,000.00 - $231,540.00

Title: Senior Delivery & Engagement Manager
Description:
We are looking for Senior Delivery & Engagement Manager in Tampa FL

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Delivery & Engagement Manager to serve as the cornerstone of our client relationships and the owner of delivery excellence. This role is critical to achieving our strategic vision, moving beyond staffing to become a trusted advisor who delivers high-value transformation programs. You will be the single point of accountability for the end-to-end delivery of services, ensuring client satisfaction, operational excellence, and profitability for a portfolio of key accounts. Your leadership will be instrumental in successfully delivering major modernization programs involving IBM i, IBM Z, cloud migration, and AI integration.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Client Engagement & Relationship Management:**

* Act as the primary trusted advisor and single point of contact for senior client stakeholders (IT Directors, VPs, CTOs), understanding their strategic business goals and ensuring our delivery aligns with their objectives.
* Build and maintain strong, strategic relationships at the operational and tactical level to ensure smooth day-to-day operations and manage escalations effectively.
* Present a unified front with the Client Partner (Sales), ensuring commercial promises are deliverable and deeply understanding the sales context to maintain client trust.

**2. End-to-End Delivery Leadership:**

* **IBM i / IBM Z Modernization**
* **Managed Services & Support:**

**3. Commercial & Financial Management (P&L Ownership):**

* Ensure all delivered services are within the scope of contracts (SOW, MSA) and manage change requests for out-of-scope work.
* Collaborate with resource managers to ensure optimal staffing with the right skills, managing both capacity and demand.

**4. Operational Excellence & Governance:**

* Establish and lead a robust governance framework. Conduct regular operational reviews, SteerCo meetings, and performance reporting sessions with clients.
* Monitor, report on, and demonstrate value against all agreed-upon SLAs, KPIs, and metrics (CSAT, utilization, financial performance).
* Ensure the adherence to and continuous improvement of delivery processes.

**5. Strategic Growth & Innovation:**

* Partner with the Client Partner to identify and qualify
  **upsell/cross-sell opportunities**
  based on client needs discovered during delivery, feeding intelligence to fuel account growth.
* Play a key role in
  **contract renewals**
  by ensuring such exceptional service delivery that the client chooses to renew and expand.
* Champion the adoption of AI-enabled delivery and new service offerings within your accounts.

**6. Global Team Leadership & Communication:**

* Provide direct leadership and direction to integrated on-shore, near-shore, and off-shore delivery teams, including Project Managers, team leaders, and technical architects.
* Serve as the key liaison, effectively communicating and aligning
  **US-based leadership (sales, executive) and India-based delivery leadership and teams**
  .
* Represent the client’s needs internally and advocate for the necessary resources and support to ensure their success.
* Foster a collaborative, high-performance environment across geographical and cultural boundaries.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **15+ years of experience**
  in Delivery Management, Engagement Management, or similar client-facing leadership role within an IT services or consulting organization.
* **Proven experience managing a portfolio of accounts**
  and the ability to handle multiple client assignments concurrently.
* **Demonstrable expertise**

* **Legacy Systems:**
  Deep understanding of IBM i (AS400), IBM Z, RPG, COBOL, and associated modernization paths.
* **Modern Stack:**
  Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), application development (.NET, Java), and integration middleware (API, MuleSoft, Boomi).

  Strong background in ITIL-based service delivery and SLA management.

  , with proven experience building trust with both technical and executive-level clients.
* **Experience leading and motivating globally distributed teams**
  (US, India, etc.) is essential.
* **Strategic mindset**
  with the ability to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.

**What We Offer**

* A pivotal leadership role in a company undergoing a significant and exciting strategic transformation.
* The opportunity to work with large, enterprise clients on complex, cutting-edge transformation programs.
* A competitive compensation package, including benefits and performance-based incentives.
* A remote-first work culture with a focus on outcomes.
* The chance to be a key player in achieving an ambitious growth vision

Title: Senior Program Delivery Manager
Description:
Applause is seeking an experienced delivery leader to oversee a complex portfolio of digital quality services for a strategic enterprise customer. This person will serve as the senior connection point between customer stakeholders and Applause’s delivery organization, ensuring that testing programs are well governed, properly resourced, measurable, and aligned with agreed business outcomes.
  
  
The
**Senior Program Delivery Manager**
will provide unified oversight across testing workstreams, lead a team of Localization Quality Account Managers (LQAMs), and partner with Testing Services, Account Management, Community Operations, Product, and other internal teams. The role is accountable for the quality, consistency, and business value of Applause-delivered services.
  
  
This position partners closely with the customer’s designated internal program owner. Customer-side decisions—including internal strategy, policy, prioritization, organizational alignment, and program ownership—remain with the customer. The Senior Program Delivery Manager ensures that Applause understands those decisions and translates them into an effective service-delivery strategy.
  
  
This is a remote position with limited travel.
  
  
**Responsilities**
**Program and Service Delivery**

* Own the overall governance and delivery health of a large, multifaceted digital quality engagement.
* Provide coordinated oversight across relevant Applause testing services, including localization-related quality initiatives.
* Translate customer objectives and testing requirements into executable service plans, workstreams, milestones, and measurable outcomes.
* Establish clear ownership, operating procedures, escalation paths, and decision-making frameworks across the engagement.
* Ensure that deliverables, schedules, service levels, testing coverage, and customer expectations are consistently managed.
* Anticipate delivery risks, dependencies, capacity constraints, and changes in customer demand; create and drive mitigation plans.
* Maintain clear boundaries between Applause-delivered services and customer-owned responsibilities, escalating scope ambiguity or conflicting expectations when necessary.
* Build a resilient operating model with documented processes, distributed ownership, and appropriate backup coverage.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and coordinate a team of LQAMs responsible for day-to-day delivery across assigned workstreams.
* Establish clear roles, work allocation, performance expectations, communication standards, and escalation responsibilities.
* Coach team members on delivery strategy, customer communication, risk management, and executive-level value articulation.
* Balance resources and capacity across workstreams while maintaining continuity during periods of change, leave, or shifting priorities.
* Promote shared accountability and consistent delivery practices across the broader account team.

**Governance, Reporting, and Business Insights**

* Establish and manage the engagement’s operating cadence, including delivery reviews, stakeholder updates, risk reviews, and executive governance.
* Ensure that program reporting is accurate, timely, consistent, and supported by reliable data.
* Monitor and communicate service performance through meaningful KPIs, including testing coverage, delivery progress, quality trends, utilization, risks, and business outcomes.
* Lead preparation for quarterly business reviews and other executive-level presentations.
* Turn testing and delivery data into clear recommendations, insights, and decision-support for customer and Applause leadership.
* Ensure that action items, decisions, risks, and dependencies are documented and followed through to completion.

**Stakeholder and Partner Management**

* Develop trusted relationships with customer stakeholders while representing Applause’s responsibilities, capabilities, and commitments clearly.
* Partner with the customer’s internal program lead to align Applause delivery with customer-defined priorities.
* Coordinate Applause Account Management, Testing Services, Community Operations, Product, Engineering, and other internal teams around a unified delivery strategy.
* Manage dependencies involving external partners or vendors when they affect Applause service delivery.
* Provide a clear escalation point for delivery challenges, cross-functional dependencies, and stakeholder concerns.
* Communicate effectively across operational, technical, and executive audiences.

**Account Health & Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate engagement health and recommend changes to delivery models, testing strategy, team structure, or resource allocation.
* Identify opportunities to increase service value, testing effectiveness, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Account Management on scope management, renewals, and appropriate expansion opportunities.
* Capture repeatable practices and contribute them to Applause delivery standards.
* Reduce operational complexity and key-person dependency through documentation, standardization, and thoughtful delegation.

**Measures of Success**
**Success In This Role Will Be Demonstrated Through**

* Consistent achievement of delivery commitments and service levels.
* Strong customer confidence in Applause’s delivery organization.
* Accurate, decision-ready reporting and reliable executive-review preparation.
* Clear accountability across Applause, customer, and partner teams.
* Early identification and effective mitigation of delivery risks.
* Healthy utilization, capacity planning, and resource continuity.
* Effective leadership and development of the LQAM team.
* Measurable improvements in testing value, quality coverage, and operational efficiency.
* Appropriate separation between Applause service ownership and the customer’s internal program responsibilities.

**Essential Skills**

* Strong service-delivery and program-governance leadership in complex enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead senior delivery professionals through direct or matrixed management.
* Advanced program-management capabilities, including planning, scope management, capacity forecasting, risk mitigation, change management, and executive governance.
* Working knowledge of software testing, digital quality practices, and managed testing services.
* Familiarity with localization quality programs and globally distributed delivery models.
* Ability to translate technical and operational data into compelling business insights.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
* Strong judgment when navigating ambiguous ownership, competing stakeholder needs, or changing priorities.
* Ability to build trusted customer relationships while maintaining clear organizational and commercial boundaries.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets, presentation tools, reporting platforms, and remote collaboration systems.
* A solutions-oriented approach with a strong commitment to customer, team, and delivery success.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Eight or more years of experience in enterprise program delivery, implementation, consulting, managed services, or customer engagement leadership.
* Five or more years of technical program or service-delivery management experience within a digital product, software, testing, or technology-services environment.
* Experience overseeing multiple interdependent workstreams within a large enterprise engagement.
* Experience managing or leading distributed, cross-functional teams.
* Experience presenting program performance, risks, and business value to senior and executive stakeholders.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with digital quality, crowdsourced testing, or testing-as-a-service models.
* Experience supporting global products or localization-related testing programs.
* Experience designing governance and reporting structures for complex strategic accounts.
* Experience leading a program through organizational transition or operating-model change.

**Compensation**
Beyond Applause’s award-winning culture, our employee-centric benefits and competitive compensation strategy are designed to support your physical and mental well-being, promote work-life balance, and fuel your professional growth.
  
  
The salary range for this position is $160,000 - $200,000.
  
  
**What Makes Applause a Great Place To Work**
Applause is a place where everyone belongs and where we believe everyone deserves the exceptional. We continue to celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive, equitable environment for our employees. If you believe you require a reasonable accommodation or any of the legally protected characteristics, please click here to complete an accommodation request. Please note, Applause will only review requests for applications that have been submitted. We will review your qualifications and follow up with you regarding your request if your qualifications meet our current needs.

Title: Program Management Manager
Description:
**Job Description**
**Program Manager - Operations Manager – Oracle Health Cloud Infrastructure & Disaster Recovery**
**Position Overview**
We are seeking an experienced, highly motivated
**Operations Manager**
to lead a team responsible for cloud infrastructure operations, client disaster recovery environments, operational project delivery, and enterprise healthcare technology solutions.
  
  
This position combines
**people leadership, cloud operations, project management, and client relationship management**
. The successful candidate will oversee a team of operations associates while actively participating in the coordination, provisioning, maintenance, and support of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) environments, CareAware cloud solutions, and infrastructure supporting Oracle Health applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on operational leader who can manage multiple competing priorities, coordinate complex infrastructure projects, communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, and ensure the successful delivery of cloud services to healthcare clients.
  
  
**Candidates with experience supporting Cerner Millennium Electronic Health Record (EHR) environments are strongly preferred.**
Familiarity with Millennium infrastructure, healthcare application dependencies, client upgrades, and the operational requirements of mission-critical healthcare systems will be particularly valuable.
  
  
This role requires someone comfortable balancing managerial responsibilities with operational execution, including cloud resource provisioning, network configuration requests, disaster recovery coordination, infrastructure troubleshooting, and healthcare application support coordination.
  
  
***This role will be based in Nashville TN - we do offer relocation assistance***
**Responsibilities**
**People Management & Team Leadership**

* Provide direct management, coaching, mentoring, and professional development for a team of approximately 8 operations associates.
* Manage day-to-day team operations, including workload distribution, project assignments, support responsibilities, and resource planning.
* Establish, maintain, and coordinate on-call rotations to ensure appropriate coverage for production environments, critical infrastructure, and client support needs.
* Monitor team capacity and priorities to ensure project commitments and operational support obligations are met.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance evaluations, development discussions, and team meetings.
* Provide guidance, training, and mentorship to project managers and operations associates.
* Promote accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement across the team.
* Coordinate escalations, remove operational blockers, and ensure critical issues receive appropriate attention and resolution.

**Disaster Recovery Operations & Client Project Management**

* Lead and coordinate client disaster recovery (DR) infrastructure projects from initial planning through implementation, validation, and ongoing operational support.
* Serve as a primary point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders regarding disaster recovery environments, project timelines, infrastructure requirements, and operational readiness.
* Facilitate recurring weekly client meetings to review DR environment health, project progress, outstanding issues, upcoming changes, and operational priorities.
* Provide regular status reports, project updates, risk assessments, and action-item tracking for client disaster recovery environments.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, networking, virtualization, and application teams to ensure disaster recovery environments meet established operational requirements.
* Oversee infrastructure provisioning, configuration requests, maintenance activities, and environment readiness.
* Track project milestones, dependencies, infrastructure issues, and deliverables using Jira and other project management tools.
* Coordinate disaster recovery testing and validation activities with appropriate operations teams and client stakeholders.
* Identify risks and escalate issues that could impact client recovery capabilities, service availability, or project timelines.
* Maintain accurate documentation of DR environments, infrastructure configurations, client requirements, and operational procedures.
* Coordinate disaster recovery planning and operational readiness activities for environments supporting healthcare applications, including Cerner Millennium and related Oracle Health solutions, where applicable.

**Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Administration & Operations**

* Utilize the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Console and associated tools to support provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of cloud infrastructure resources.
* Provision and manage OCI compute instances, including virtual machine creation, configuration, and deployment activities.
* Coordinate and implement network Access Control List (ACL) and Network Security Group (NSG) requests in accordance with established security and change management procedures.
* Support virtual cloud network (VCN) configurations, subnet assignments, and network connectivity requirements.
* Perform basic network troubleshooting within the OCI Console, including reviewing security rules, routing configurations, subnet settings, and connectivity-related issues.
* Collaborate with networking, virtualization, DevOps, and infrastructure operations teams to investigate and resolve cloud infrastructure issues.
* Assist with infrastructure upgrades, migrations, resource changes, and environment maintenance activities.
* Ensure cloud infrastructure changes are appropriately documented, tracked, and communicated to affected stakeholders.
* Support operational best practices for infrastructure reliability, security, availability, and disaster recovery readiness.

**Oracle Health & Cerner Millennium EHR Operations**

* Support the coordination and operational management of infrastructure and cloud environments associated with Oracle Health applications, including Cerner Millennium EHR and CareAware solutions.
* Work with Oracle Health application teams, infrastructure operations, networking, and client stakeholders to coordinate environment provisioning, upgrades, migrations, and operational support activities.
* Apply knowledge of Cerner Millennium environments and healthcare application dependencies to identify potential infrastructure risks and coordinate appropriate resolution.
* Assist in planning and coordinating infrastructure changes that may affect Millennium-connected applications, integrations, or supporting healthcare services.
* Collaborate with application owners and operations teams to support availability, reliability, and continuity of mission-critical healthcare systems.
* Coordinate client communications, project timelines, and operational readiness activities for infrastructure initiatives involving Millennium and related Oracle Health solutions.
* Demonstrate an understanding of the importance of minimizing service disruptions in healthcare environments and maintaining appropriate operational controls during infrastructure changes.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to investigate infrastructure-related issues affecting healthcare applications and coordinate escalations through resolution.

**Operational Project & Service Delivery Management**

* Oversee multiple concurrent operational initiatives involving cloud infrastructure, application migrations, client upgrades, disaster recovery, and service improvements.
* Assign and prioritize project work and support Jira tickets based on business needs, operational complexity, resource availability, and client commitments.
* Coordinate across product engineering, networking, virtualization, DevOps, consulting, and client-facing teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Lead infrastructure modernization and migration initiatives, including operating system upgrades and legacy server replacement.
* Work with client stakeholders to establish migration timelines, resolve dependencies, and encourage timely adoption of supported infrastructure platforms.
* Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure costs, third-party licensing expenses, operational overhead, and infrastructure-related risks.
* Maintain project schedules, action items, risks, dependencies, and status communications.
* Support both planned project activities and unplanned operational escalations while maintaining clear priorities and accountability.
* Coordinate infrastructure and application modernization efforts within healthcare environments while considering operational dependencies and client service continuity.

**Process Improvement, Jira Management & Documentation**

* Develop, maintain, and improve Jira workflows, issue templates, project templates, and operational tracking processes.
* Create standardized project and support request templates to improve consistency, visibility, and execution efficiency.
* Establish repeatable procedures for client onboarding, cloud provisioning, infrastructure requests, disaster recovery support, and project delivery.
* Improve coordination between account managers, project managers, operations associates, and engineering teams.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive administrative or operational tasks.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, operational runbooks, escalation procedures, and project records.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase team productivity, reduce manual effort, and improve client service delivery.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in IT operations, infrastructure management, cloud services, service delivery, or a related operational leadership role.
* Demonstrated experience leading, supervising, or mentoring operations professionals.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent infrastructure and operational initiatives.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure concepts, including virtual machines, compute resources, networking, and infrastructure provisioning.
* Experience working with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or a comparable enterprise cloud platform.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, subnets, routing, ACLs, security groups, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience coordinating client-facing operational projects and communicating with diverse stakeholders.
* Familiarity with disaster recovery concepts, infrastructure availability, business continuity, and operational support processes.
* Experience using Jira or similar platforms for project tracking, support ticket management, and workload assignment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, troubleshooting, and escalation management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead client meetings and provide clear operational project updates.
* Ability to balance strategic team management responsibilities with hands-on infrastructure and operational work.
* Understanding of operational change management and service availability requirements in enterprise production environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**
**Oracle Health and Cerner Millennium Experience**

* Experience supporting Cerner Millennium EHR environments is strongly preferred, particularly in infrastructure operations, application support coordination, upgrades, migrations, or disaster recovery.
* Familiarity with the Cerner Millennium ecosystem, including its supporting infrastructure, application dependencies, and integration with other Oracle Health solutions.
* Experience working within Oracle Health, Cerner, or comparable enterprise healthcare technology environments.
* Understanding of the operational requirements associated with supporting mission-critical EHR systems in hospital or health system environments.
* Experience coordinating infrastructure changes, maintenance activities, or application upgrades affecting Cerner Millennium environments.
* Familiarity with CareAware applications and their integration or operational dependencies within the broader Oracle Health ecosystem.
* Experience collaborating with healthcare client IT departments, application support teams, infrastructure teams, and implementation stakeholders.
* Knowledge of healthcare IT service availability, business continuity, change management, and disaster recovery considerations.

**Cloud Infrastructure And Operational Experience**

* Direct experience administering or supporting Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), including compute instances, virtual cloud networks, subnets, security lists, and network security groups.
* Familiarity with disaster recovery infrastructure planning, testing, failover coordination, and environment maintenance.
* Experience managing cloud appliance procurement, hardware deployment, or vendor coordination.
* Experience working with HPE infrastructure or enterprise hardware vendors.
* Knowledge of Windows Server infrastructure, operating system migrations, virtualization, and server lifecycle management.
* Experience collaborating with DevOps, network operations, virtualization operations, and application development teams.
* Familiarity with ITIL processes, change management, incident management, and production support operations.
* Experience developing Jira templates, workflow improvements, infrastructure documentation, and standardized operational processes.
* Experience coordinating operational projects across geographically distributed teams and international client environments.
* Relevant cloud, infrastructure, project management, or IT service management certifications are a plus.

**Key Skills & Competencies**
**Operational Leadership:**
Ability to lead operations associates, assign work effectively, mentor team members, and maintain operational accountability.
  
  
**Cloud Infrastructure Operations:**
Working knowledge of OCI, compute provisioning, virtual networking, infrastructure operations, and basic troubleshooting.
  
  
**Disaster Recovery Management:**
Ability to coordinate client DR projects, manage environment readiness, communicate operational status, and organize recovery activities.
  
  
**Healthcare Application Awareness:**
Understanding of the operational demands of enterprise healthcare applications, particularly Cerner Millennium EHR, CareAware, and related Oracle Health solutions.
  
  
**Project Execution:**
Strong planning, prioritization, tracking, and cross-functional coordination skills.
  
  
**Client Communication:**
Confidence leading client-facing operational meetings, managing expectations, and communicating risks, issues, and project progress.
  
  
**Operational Excellence:**
Commitment to improving support processes, documentation, service reliability, and team efficiency.
  
  
**Problem Solving:**
Ability to assess infrastructure and operational challenges, coordinate appropriate resources, and drive timely resolution.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to:
  
  

* Maintain a well-organized, effective operations team with clear ownership of projects, support responsibilities, and on-call coverage.
* Successfully coordinate and deliver client disaster recovery projects while maintaining reliable ongoing support of DR environments.
* Ensure timely completion of OCI compute provisioning, network security requests, and infrastructure configuration activities.
* Build strong working relationships with clients, internal engineering teams, project managers, and external vendors.
* Effectively coordinate infrastructure and operational initiatives supporting Oracle Health applications, including Cerner Millennium and CareAware environments.
* Apply an understanding of healthcare application dependencies to proactively identify operational risks and minimize disruptions to client services.
* Improve the efficiency and consistency of Jira project management, operational workflows, and support processes.
* Proactively identify and resolve risks that could affect infrastructure availability, project delivery, or client satisfaction.
* Balance people management, infrastructure execution, and project leadership to support the continued growth and reliability of cloud-based healthcare solutions.

**Ideal Candidate**
We are looking for a
**hands-on Operations Manager who enjoys staying involved in day-to-day cloud infrastructure and service delivery operations**
.
  
  
This individual should be equally comfortable coaching team members, leading a client disaster recovery meeting, coordinating a complex infrastructure deployment, assigning Jira work, or navigating the OCI Console to provision compute resources and investigate basic networking issues.
  
  
**An especially strong candidate will bring previous experience working with Cerner Millennium EHR environments**
, providing valuable insight into the infrastructure dependencies, operational challenges, and service continuity expectations associated with supporting enterprise healthcare applications.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a combination of leadership, operational expertise, organizational discipline, healthcare industry awareness, and strong client communication skills. They take ownership of challenges, proactively remove obstacles, and continuously look for ways to improve how operations teams deliver services.

Title: Information Technology Operations Manager
Description:
Performs highly advanced managerial work administering the daily operations and activities of the Information Technology Services (ITS) Cloud Operations function. The Cloud Operations Manager leads staff responsible for the agency's cloud, infrastructure, and technology operations and ensures services support client programs reliably, securely, and efficiently.

Work involves establishing goals, priorities, guidelines, procedures, and service standards; directing staff performance and development; coordinating daily operations and modernization initiatives; evaluating service performance and operational risk; developing and monitoring budget requests and expenditures; and recommending improvements. The position coordinates with ITS teams, security and governance partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to align services and resources with agency needs.

**What Your Contributions to the client will be:**

* People Leadership & Team Management: Directly supervises and supports individual contributors by setting expectations, assigning and prioritizing work, monitoring performance, providing coaching and feedback, and supporting professional development. Builds a cohesive, accountable team environment; addresses performance issues; and ensures staff have the skills, tools, and resources needed to meet operational objectives.
* Operational Execution & Team Delivery: Executes established strategies and plans by coordinating day-to-day team activities, managing priorities and schedules, tracking progress against goals, and resolving operational issues. Ensures work is completed accurately, on time, and in alignment with agency policies, standards, and service expectations.
* Cloud Strategy & Infrastructure Modernization: Leads planning and modernization of the agency's cloud and infrastructure environments. Sets priorities for cloud readiness, migration, platform lifecycle, capacity, and technical debt reduction. Coordinates with technology teams and business stakeholders to align work with agency needs.
* Infrastructure Reliability, Continuity & Disaster Recovery: Oversees the reliability and availability of infrastructure services, including continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing. Directs work to improve backup, recovery, monitoring, capacity, and service resilience, and tracks recovery objectives for critical systems.
* Security, Risk & Compliance: Coordinates with security and governance partners to reduce operational risk and support compliance. Oversees implementation of approved controls for access management, secure configuration, network protection, logging, vulnerability remediation, and audit response across infrastructure services.
* Budget, Procurement & Vendor Oversight: Monitors budgets, procurement, contracts, and vendor performance for CloudOps services. Evaluates resource needs and technology options, monitors expenditures, and recommends investments that support agency priorities and operational efficiency.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, engineering, business administration, or a related field; relevant education and experience may be considered in combination.
* At least eight (8) years of progressively responsible experience in information technology operations, infrastructure, cloud services, systems administration, or a closely related field.
* At least three (3) years of experience supervising or leading technical staff, including assigning work, setting expectations, monitoring performance, and supporting staff development.
* Experience coordinating technology operations or modernization work across teams, assessing service risks, and communicating status and recommendations to leadership and stakeholders.
* Experience supporting infrastructure reliability, security controls, service continuity, or disaster recovery in an enterprise environment.

**Location Requirement:**
This position is based in Austin, TX. Candidates must be currently located in the Austin area or willing to relocate at their own expense. Relocation assistance is not provided.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ten or more years of progressively responsible experience in IT operations, cloud or infrastructure services, or technology service delivery, including several years in a management role.
* Experience in a state agency, public-sector, or similarly regulated environment, including familiarity with security, audit, procurement, and records requirements.
* Experience with cloud adoption and migration, hybrid infrastructure, identity and access management, enterprise networking, backup and recovery, and monitoring or observability.
* Experience managing operating budgets, service contracts, vendors, and technology lifecycle planning.
* Experience with IT service management, change control, incident response, and service performance measures.

**Physical Requirements:**

This position requires the employee to primarily perform sedentary office work; however, mobility (moving around the worksite) is routinely required to carry out some duties. This position requires extensive computer, telephone and client/ customer contact and communication. It requires the ability to move and position oneself as needed for filing and similar routine office duties. The job also requires normal cognitive abilities requiring the ability to learn, recall, and apply certain practices and policies. It requires the stamina to maintain attention to detail despite interruptions. Ability to read printed materials and computer screens. The individual must be able to move and transport records, documents, boxes, and all related information and materials, weighing up to 20 pounds when required.

Email is one of MetLife’s highest-volume and most business-critical marketing channels, supporting many programs across customer and employer audiences. * Lead end-to-end email operations, including intake, production, quality control, deliverability, vendor management, and continuous process improvement to increase efficiency, quality, and speed-to-market.

* Manage external email execution vendors by monitoring performance, capacity, quality, budgets, contracts, and documentation while ensuring strong knowledge transfer and reducing dependency on individual resources.
* Support marketing automation and customer journey initiatives by operationalizing triggered campaigns, maintaining governance and quality standards, monitoring live programs, coordinating with batch campaigns, and leveraging reporting, testing, and performance insights to drive continuous improvement.

* 8+ years of experience in email marketing operations, campaign execution, or marketing automation, including managing external vendors or agency partners and supporting large-scale email programs.
* Hands-on expertise with enterprise marketing automation platforms such as Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or similar solutions, including the development and management of automated customer journeys.
* Proven ability to design, optimize, and scale email intake, production, quality assurance, and delivery processes while maintaining high standards of operational efficiency and campaign performance.
* Strong understanding of audience segmentation, personalization strategies, consent and preference management, and email deliverability best practices, including sender reputation, authentication, and list hygiene.
* Experience leveraging generative AI and automation tools to improve content development, quality control, troubleshooting, capacity planning, and overall marketing operations within enterprise governance frameworks.
* Analytical and collaborative professional with experience measuring campaign and operational performance, translating insights into action, and partnering effectively across marketing, technology, compliance, and vendor teams to drive business outcomes.

* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, insurance, or healthcare, including B2B2C and B2C programs.
* Experience working with product owners in an agile delivery model.

Title: Project Manager
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

**Cat5 Resources is a certified Woman-Owned Business providing technical and operational services to critical infrastructure across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.**

  
  

Since 2013, we’ve supported telecommunications, utilities, and essential industries with services including **Disaster Recovery, Operations and Maintenance, Electrical, Civil and Construction, and Transportation and Logistics.** In 2016, we expanded into Puerto Rico with **Cat5 Caribbean**, and in 2024, we launched **Cat5 Power Solutions** to deliver portable power sales and rentals across the region.

  
  

We are committed to powering and protecting the infrastructure that keeps businesses and communities running—whether during daily operations or times of disaster.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Fueling for Data Center**
================================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager leads Cat5’s preventive maintenance and fueling program for a national wireless infrastructure client, with a fleet made up mostly of portable generators. The role coordinates scheduled maintenance, routine and emergency fuel deliveries, portable unit deployment and recovery, field personnel and vendors, safety, client communications, and complete service and fuel-delivery documentation.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

  

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

  

**Location**

Mostly on-site in North Texas, with travel to vendor shops and field sites

  

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.

* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).

* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.

* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, on-time fueling, emergency response, fuel-delivery accuracy and work-order closeout.

* Protect client confidential information.

* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.

* Track every scheduled maintenance visit and fueling commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and fueling operations**

* Oversee scheduled preventive maintenance inspections and servicing of portable generators and, where applicable, installed generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).

* Review maintenance findings, identify deficiencies and coordinate escalation of repair needs to the appropriate repair team for client approval.

* Plan recurring generator fueling, fuel-level checks and emergency refueling based on client requirements, site access and generator operating needs.

* Coordinate routine portable generator checks, operational testing and follow-up on deficiencies identified during preventive maintenance, including ATS checks where applicable.

* Enforce quality standards through maintenance checklists, fuel-delivery tickets, meter readings, photographs and complete site-level work-order records.

* Investigate missed services, fueling discrepancies, fuel shortages and repeat service issues; document corrective actions.

* Ensure preventive maintenance and fueling activities follow applicable safety, spill-prevention, environmental and fuel-handling requirements.

* Ensure technicians record generator condition, alarms, fluid levels, battery checks, fuel levels and test results during service visits.

* Obtain required client approvals for nonroutine fueling, emergency deliveries and out-of-scope maintenance before proceeding.

* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and fueling history for each serviced asset and site.

* Track portable generator inventory, location, deployment, transport and return, recording unit ID, run hours and condition at each move.

* Coordinate qualified maintenance subcontractors, fuel suppliers and delivery partners when work cannot be self-performed.

* Escalate generator faults, fuel-system concerns, suspected leaks and repair needs with supporting site documentation.

**Fuel, parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of preventive maintenance supplies, filters, fluids and approved fueling resources.

* Forecast maintenance supplies and fuel-delivery demand based on schedules, site consumption and seasonal or emergency needs.

* Publish reports on fuel deliveries, consumption, maintenance supplies, missed visits and service delays.

* Coordinate approved fuel suppliers and maintenance-material vendors, including delivery coverage and service expectations.

* Record maintenance materials, delivered fuel quantities, delivery confirmations and associated costs in designated systems.

* Use maintenance schedules, historical fuel usage and generator run time to plan service materials and fueling requirements.

* Review fuel-supply capacity, delivery lead times and critical maintenance materials with the client.

* Support client audits of maintenance records, fuel tickets, invoices and vendor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes, fueling dispatches and portable generator deployments based on geography, site priority and personnel qualifications.

* Monitor technician and fuel-vendor productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.

* Coordinate follow-up maintenance visits, missed fuel deliveries and client communication for incomplete work.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site preventive maintenance schedules, fueling routes, dispatch priorities and travel logistics.

* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and fuel deliveries within contractual service windows.

* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, low-fuel conditions and delivery delays; keep the client informed.

* Track maintenance and fueling work orders, assigned personnel, delivery dates, gallons delivered and outstanding actions.

* Close out each work order with service details, fuel quantities, delivery tickets, photographs and client-required documentation.

* Investigate recurring service exceptions, fuel discrepancies, incomplete deliveries and quality concerns.

* Ensure proper handling of fuels and service waste, including spill response and reporting under applicable procedures.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, routine fueling, emergency refueling and portable generator deployment at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.

* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, maintenance, fuel logistics or telecom infrastructure.

* 3+ years working with portable and standby diesel or natural gas generators; automatic transfer switch (ATS) experience is a plus.

* Working knowledge of Generac, Kohler and other portable generator platforms and their controllers.

* Experience managing generator preventive maintenance and fueling programs with field documentation and quality controls.

* Experience with fuel logistics, delivery verification, vendor coordination and maintenance-material planning.

* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.

* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, fueling requirements and service scopes.

* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.

* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.

* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.

* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.

* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.

* Experience with generator fueling, emergency fuel delivery, fuel monitoring and remote field service.

* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.

* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.

* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in North Texas, with coordination of remote field operations.

* Travel to fuel vendors, maintenance partners and field sites, up to 40% of the time.

* Availability outside normal hours for emergency fueling, portable generator deployment, generator outages and storm response.

* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.

* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion, fueling delivery and work-order closeout.

* Fueling dispatch, emergency delivery and maintenance response within contract requirements.

* Every maintenance visit and fuel delivery documented with required readings, quantities and asset identification.

* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.

* Improved generator readiness, fewer low-fuel incidents and timely resolution of maintenance deficiencies.

* Accurate fuel reconciliation, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.

* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

Title: eTrading Engineering Lead
Description:

In Canada, HSBC Global Services (Canada) Limited (HGCA) is a wholly owned subsidiary of HSBC Global Services Limited. Operating in Toronto, HGCA is part of a global service company, delivering services to support the operating entities of HSBC Group. We have different capabilities that provide tools and processes to facilitate the functions, business, and entities with their service management responsibilities.
  
  
**Ready to shape the infrastructure behind low-latency electronic trading platforms?**
**Why HSBC**
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Join Markets and Securities Services Information Technology (IT) as Regional Head of electronic Trading (eTrading) Infrastructure Engineering in Toronto, Canada. This role owns the regional infrastructure engineering capability supporting latency-sensitive and collocated electronic trading platforms. You’ll manage two infrastructure engineers while staying hands-on across data center compute, Linux, server hardware, network switching, and exchange connectivity. You’ll take end-to-end accountability for the regional infrastructure delivery pipeline aligned to agreed business priorities, alongside operational service performance and the regional risk and control agenda. Success means resilient, secure, and cost-effective services, strong control outcomes, and well-governed delivery across collocated data centers and exchange-facing infrastructure.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Oversee and develop two infrastructure engineers, setting objectives, allocating work, and building succession and capability plans
* Own the regional delivery pipeline and roadmap, translating business priorities into committed plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes while managing dependencies and trade-offs
* Manage the regional infrastructure budget, forecasts, and investment cases, controlling capital and operating expenditure and supplier and hardware lifecycle decisions
* Govern service availability, capacity, resilience, and support readiness, coordinating incident, problem, change, and recovery through to permanent remediation
* Own the regional risk and control environment, including technology risk assessment, audit and regulatory actions, security and firmware compliance, evidence quality, and timely issue closure
* Design, build, configure, and troubleshoot infrastructure across collocated and enterprise data centers including Linux platforms, physical servers, network switches, cabling, out-of-band management, and low-latency connectivity
* Define and maintain regional reference architectures, engineering standards, design blueprints, build patterns, and operational procedures aligned with global strategy
* Build repeatable infrastructure delivery and validation pipelines using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automated testing, contributing production-quality Java and Ansible code
* Stakeholder management: Partner with trading business, application engineering, architecture, cyber security, operations, risk, finance, procurement, vendors, exchanges and carriers to deliver regional outcomes.
* Regional execution: Lead data-centre builds, migrations, refreshes and exchange onboarding, coordinating suppliers and remote-hands teams and providing hands-on support during critical implementations and incidents.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bring substantial hands-on experience in infrastructure, network, or compute engineering with accountability for regional or business-critical services
* Manage a small engineering team, establishing priorities, assuring delivery, and developing technical capability
* Own budgets, forecasts, vendors, operational performance, and technology risk and control obligations
* Apply deep expertise across Linux, enterprise server hardware, data center and colocation environments, network switches, and physical infrastructure lifecycle management
* Use strong knowledge of low-latency networking including Transmission Control Protocol and Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), routing and switching, multicast, packet capture analysis, and exchange or market data connectivity
* Build continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) workflows and automated, version-controlled infrastructure delivery aligned to a Network Development and Operations (NetDevOps) approach
* Apply Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD) to infrastructure and network engineering using repeatable lab and pre-production validation
* Write production code in Java, or bring equivalent demonstrable production coding experience in Python or a comparable language
* Build Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Ansible including reusable roles and playbooks, automated testing, and integration into delivery pipelines
* Experience supporting electronic trading, market-data or other latency-sensitive financial services infrastructure.
* Professional network certification such as CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure or Data Center, or equivalent depth of experience.
* Experience with Docker, Containerlab, Molecule, Jira, Confluence and CI platforms such as TeamCity.

As an HSBC employee, you will have access to tailored professional development opportunities to ensure you have the right skills for today and tomorrow. We offer a competitive pay and benefits package including a robust Wellness Hub, all in a welcoming and inclusive work environment. You will be empowered to drive HSBC’s engagement with the communities we serve through an industry-leading volunteerism policy, a generous matching gift program, and a comprehensive program of immersive Sustainability and Climate Change Initiatives. You’ll want to join our Employee Resource Groups as they play a central part in life at HSBC, including the development of our employees and networking inside and outside of HSBC. We value difference. We succeed together. We take responsibility. We get it done. And we want you to help us build the bank of the future!
