Title: Technical Operations Center Manager
Description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
  
  
As a Technical Operations Center (TOC) Manager, you will be one of three global managers operating in a "Follow the Sun" model, ensuring continuous 24/7 coverage and operational excellence across our technical infrastructure. This role is accountable for more than ticket throughput. It turns operational signals into measurable reliability outcomes by strengthening service ownership, leading disciplined incident response, reducing repeat failure and toil, and moving the organization toward proactive, increasingly automated operations. Your leadership will be crucial in facilitating seamless handoffs between shifts, maintaining high performance, and upholding and improving they systems and processes that create operational drag.
  
  
**Job Functions**
Service Reliability & Operational Leadership
  
  

* Lead day-to-day operations for the Technical Operations Center, ensuring critical infrastructure and services are operated safely, reliably and consistently.
* Establish and maintain a service-centric operating rhythm covering service ownership, criticality, dependencies, SLOs/SLIs, incident trends, capacity, risk and operational readiness.
* Partner with service owners, engineering, cybersecurity, business technology teams and vendors to identify reliability risks before they become business-impacting incidents.
* Use observability, telemetry and service health data to improve detection, prioritization and decision-making.
* Maintain a regular operating review and publish a concise scorecard focused on outcomes rather than activity.

Major Incident Management & Swarming
  
  

* Lead or sponsor response to major incidents, acting as Incident Commander or ensuring the appropriate command structure is in place.
* Establish clear incident roles, escalation triggers, communication standards and decision rights for high-severity events.
* Make swarming repeatable through shared queues, structured triage-ready information and timely engagement of the right technical and business partners.
* Coordinate internal teams and third-party providers through restoration, stakeholder communication and service validation.
* Ensure blameless postmortems convert incident learning into prioritized problem-management, reliability and prevention work.

Problem Management, Toil Reduction & Automation
  
  

* Maintain a ranked backlog of repeat incidents, operational toil, alert noise and manual work, with owners and measurable outcomes.
* Drive the conversion of repeatable procedures into versioned runbooks, scripts, workflows, automation and self-service capabilities.
* Apply AI-assisted triage and knowledge discovery where appropriate, with human oversight, security controls, auditability and clear escalation paths.
* Improve the quality, findability and lifecycle management of operational knowledge, including runbooks, known-error records, as-builts and shift documentation.
* Track automation adoption and toil hours avoided using the results to redirect capacity toward reliability engineering and service improvement.

Change, Release & Operational Readiness
  
  

* Strengthen risk-tiered change practices, including pre-checks, peer review, testing evidence, implementation plans, monitoring and rollback readiness.
* Partner with engineering and delivery teams to shift operational readiness earlier in the lifecycle, including supportability, observability, runbooks and ownership before release.
* Analyze change-related incidents and failure patterns leading corrective actions that improve change success and reduce recovery time.
* Support paved-road standards and a transparent exception process for common infrastructure, cloud, identity, network and systems patterns.

Global Coordination & Follow-the-Sun Operations
  
  

* Facilitate structured handoffs between global teams, ensuring the incoming shift receives current service health, active incidents, risks, decisions, next actions and escalation needs.
* Maintain consistent severity, response, handoff, change and review practices across regions while respecting local context and coverage requirements.
* Build strong working relationships across time zones, technical domains, business units and strategic vendors.
* Participate in a rotating global coverage and escalation model, including occasional out-of-hours or weekend coverage when required. The schedule should support sustainable coverage rather than routine weekend office attendance.

People Leadership & Capability Building
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop Technical Operations Center specialists, creating a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Set clear expectations for performance, incident leadership, documentation, operational discipline and customer experience.
* Hire, onboard and develop talent while building role-based learning paths and cross-training plans for critical domains.
* Establish resilient coverage with documented SME and backup relationships, reducing key-person dependency.

**Skills/Abilities**
Job Requirements:
  
  

* Deep technical knowledge in infrastructure operations, site reliability, platform operations or related disciplines.
* Ability to assess impact, prioritize under pressure, communicate clearly and make sound decisions during high-severity events.
* Experience with service ownership, observability, SLOs/SLIs, operational readiness, runbooks and reliability metrics.
* Experience reducing operational toil through scripting, workflow automation, self-service or similar engineering practices.
* Working knowledge of cloud, identity, network, systems and/or enterprise infrastructure operations.
* Ability to build trust across engineering, security, business technology, vendors and geographically distributed teams.
* Commitment to blameless learning, continuous improvement and inclusive people leadership.

**Experience**

* Eight or more years of progressive experience in infrastructure operations, site reliability, platform operations, IT service management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Three or more years leading technical teams, major incident response, operational programs or cross-functional reliability initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience operating mission-critical infrastructure or applications in a complex, globally distributed environment.
* Strong working knowledge of incident, problem, change, service-level and knowledge-management practices.
* Experience leading a follow-the-sun operating model or global shift handoff process is preferred.

* Experience implementing or improving a service catalog, SLO framework, error-budget practices or reliability scorecard.
* Experience with ITSM, observability, automation/orchestration and knowledge-management platforms.

Education

Title: Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs
Description:
**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

Cat5 Resources is a diversified supplier of technical and operational services across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.

In 2004, when Hurricane Charley devastated Florida, our CEO, Cindy Perez, received an out-of-the-blue call from a long-term telecom client in urgent need of help. Their other vendors could not deliver, so they turned to Cindy for assistance. She responded without hesitation, mobilizing a fleet of generators and emergency fuel to ensure the client’s critical infrastructure remained operational throughout the event.

In 2013, Cindy founded Cat5 Resources with a mission to provide reliable and innovative solutions for critical infrastructure resiliency. Since then, the Cat5 Resources team has consistently delivered exceptional customer service to clients nationwide. Over the years, Cat5 Resources has expanded its offerings to include Disaster Recovery Services, Operations and Maintenance, Civil, Electrical, and Construction, as well as Transportation and Logistics.

As a certified Woman-Owned Business, Cat5 Resources serves the entire Southern United States. In 2016, we extended our services into Puerto Rico with the launch of Cat5 Caribbean, focusing on critical infrastructure support in disaster-prone regions. Further expanding our capabilities, in 2024, we introduced Cat5 Power Solutions, our Portable Power Sales and Rentals Division, delivering versatile power solutions to businesses and communities across the Southern US.

**Project Manager – Generator Preventive Maintenance & Repairs**
================================================================

**Cat5 Resources**

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator preventive maintenance and repair program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Remote with travel to field sites or client location if needed

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.
* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Maintain and update Cat5’s hours and company information in Avetta so qualification and compliance status stay current.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: preventive maintenance completion, repair response times, first-time fix rates, equipment uptime and work-order closeout.
* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every scheduled service and repair commitment; flag at-risk work orders early and communicate revised completion dates.

**Preventive maintenance and corrective repairs**

* Oversee preventive maintenance inspections and service of installed diesel and natural gas generators and ATS units.
* Review inspection findings, diagnose reported failures, and provide written repair recommendations and estimates for client approval.
* Schedule and oversee corrective repairs to controllers, alternators, starting systems, fuel systems, cooling systems, breakers, batteries, fuel tanks and enclosures.
* Coordinate ATS inspections, testing, troubleshooting and repairs, including contactors, controls, relays and communication components.
* Enforce QA through service checklists, operational testing, inspection reports, photographs and complete asset-level work-order records.
* Manage repair warranties, repeat-failure investigations and complete service documentation.
* Ensure maintenance and repairs comply with applicable safety, environmental and waste-handling requirements, including oils, coolant, batteries and fuel.
* Ensure technicians document generator operating conditions, alarms, fluid levels, battery condition and test results during site visits.
* Submit repair quotes for client approval and do not perform work requiring authorization before written approval is received.
* Maintain complete preventive maintenance and repair history for each client-owned asset.
* Coordinate qualified subcontractors and specialty repair vendors when work cannot be self-performed.
* Escalate generators requiring major repair or replacement recommendations with supporting diagnostics and cost estimates.

**Parts and materials management**

* Maintain availability of service parts, filters, fluids, batteries and critical repair components.
* Monitor critical parts stock and forecast material requirements based on scheduled maintenance and repair trends.
* Publish reports on parts usage, open repairs, backorders and material-related service delays.
* Source OEM-approved or client-authorized replacement parts through approved vendors.
* Record parts consumption and purchasing in designated systems and provide required client reporting.
* Use maintenance schedules and historical consumption to plan recurring service materials.
* Review critical spare-parts levels and lead times with the client.
* Support client audits of maintenance records, work orders and subcontractor compliance.

**Field operations and technician coordination**

* Assign preventive maintenance routes and repair dispatches based on technician qualifications, geography and priority.
* Monitor technician productivity, service quality, safety compliance and work-order completion.
* Coordinate follow-up visits, parts availability and client communication for incomplete repairs.

**Scheduling, dispatch and work-order management**

* Manage multi-site maintenance schedules, dispatch priorities and travel logistics across assigned territories.
* Complete scheduled preventive maintenance and corrective repairs within contractual service windows.
* Escalate missed appointments, access issues, outages and repair delays; keep the client informed.
* Track work-order status, technician assignments, service dates and outstanding actions.
* Close out each work order with labor, parts, test results, photographs and client-required documentation.
* Investigate repeat service calls, incomplete repairs and workmanship concerns.
* Ensure proper handling and disposal of used oil, filters, coolant, batteries and other service waste.

**Site services**

* Plan preventive maintenance visits, troubleshooting, load testing and repairs at tower and other remote sites with client operations teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, equipment repair, logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with diesel or natural gas standby generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Working knowledge of Generac and Kohler generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing field preventive maintenance and generator repair programs with testing and QA documentation.
* Parts and materials management experience: serialized asset tracking, cycle counts, stock levels and demand planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.
* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, service scopes and warranties.
* Strong Excel skills and experience with field service, maintenance management or work-order systems.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Experience with preventive maintenance programs, generator diagnostics, emergency repairs and remote field service.
* Knowledge of applicable environmental and safety requirements for fuel, fluids, batteries and field maintenance.
* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based primarily at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX, with coordination of remote field operations.
* Travel to repair vendors and field sites, up to 40% of the time.
* Availability outside normal hours for generator outages, emergency repairs and storm response.
* Field visits involve tower-site conditions, heat, noise, outdoor weather and required PPE.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time preventive maintenance completion and work-order closeout.
* Repair quote, dispatch and service response within contract requirements.
* Every service visit documented with required inspections, test results and asset identification.
* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.
* Improved generator uptime, reduced repeat failures and timely resolution of deficiencies.
* Low repeat-repair rates, strong safety performance and zero unauthorized work.
* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

---------------------

Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

**About Cat5 Resources LLC**

**Cat5 Resources is a certified Woman-Owned Business providing technical and operational services to critical infrastructure across the Southern US, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands.**

Since 2013, we’ve supported telecommunications, utilities, and essential industries with services including **Disaster Recovery, Operations and Maintenance, Electrical, Civil and Construction, and Transportation and Logistics.** In 2016, we expanded into Puerto Rico with **Cat5 Caribbean**, and in 2024, we launched **Cat5 Power Solutions** to deliver portable power sales and rentals across the region.

We are committed to powering and protecting the infrastructure that keeps businesses and communities running—whether during daily operations or times of disaster.

**Position summary**
--------------------

The Project Manager runs Cat5’s nationwide generator refurbishment and replenishment program for a national wireless infrastructure client with thousands of backup power units in service across the U.S. The role owns the full asset lifecycle: receiving decommissioned generators and ATS units, deciding repair vs. dispose, overseeing refurbishment and testing, managing stored inventory, and fulfilling orders to sites on time.

**Department**

Operations – Generator Services

**Reports to**

Director of Operations

**Location**

Mostly on-site at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX, with travel to vendor shops and field sites

**Type**

Full-time, exempt

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program and client management**

* Serve as the client’s main point of contact; run regular status meetings and escalations.
* Build and manage the program plan, budget, staffing and subcontractor mix (in-house vs. third party).
* Get all subcontractors through the client’s qualification process before they access any site.
* Track and report performance against contract SLAs: stock levels, refurbishment turnaround, fulfillment lead times and warranty claims.
* Protect client confidential information.
* Turn around client quote requests and purchase orders quickly, within contract response times.
* Track every order’s required delivery date; flag at-risk orders early with a firm revised date.

**Assessment, refurbishment and remanufacturing**

* Oversee intake of decommissioned generators, ATS units and components.
* Direct repairability assessments and give the client written repair, refurbish or dispose recommendations.
* Schedule and oversee repair of whole units and components, including controllers, alternators, fuel systems, turbos, radiators, breakers, fuel tanks and enclosures.
* Oversee ATS refurbishment: contactors, communication, transformer and relay boards, ribbon cables and enclosures.
* Enforce QA: functional testing, inspection reports, and serial-number and refurbishment-step records for every asset.
* Manage warranty claims and keep QA records for the full warranty period.
* Ensure refurbishment and disposal meet industry standards and environmental rules (fluids, batteries, scrap).
* Test incoming units promptly and log results in our inventory system.
* Send repair quotes for client approval; never repair or dispose of client equipment without written approval.
* Keep a detailed repair history for every repaired client-owned unit.
* Coordinate third-party repair shops (starters, alternators, controllers) where we don’t self-perform.
* Prepare purchase offers for non-functional equipment and manage the bill of sale process.

**Inventory management**

* Run secure, organized storage of client assets, with a preventive maintenance program for stored units.
* Keep minimum stock levels of critical components and plan replenishment against demand.
* Publish regular inventory reports: asset status, location and repair progress.
* Source parts and units through resale and secondary-market networks when stock runs short.
* Run inventory in our inventory system and give the client access and standard reporting through it.
* Build and maintain a demand planning method from usage, consumption and project data.
* Set and regularly review minimum spares levels with the client.
* Support client audits of client-owned equipment and keep required insurance current.

**Consignment and sales**

* Take in client equipment for consignment and bring it to working condition.
* Market consigned equipment, set sale prices within agreed limits, and track costs and fees.
* Remit proceeds, handle sales tax, and keep bills of sale in order.

**Logistics and order fulfillment**

* Manage nationwide transport, storage and preservation of assets, with handling and transit risk controls.
* Fulfill orders for refurbished and replacement units and parts to designated sites within agreed lead times.
* Run the escalation process for delays and keep the client informed.
* Track title and risk-of-loss transfer points on every shipment.
* Close out each order in our system with tracking and serial numbers sent to the client.
* Process dead-on-arrival returns and freight damage claims with proper documentation.
* Handle hazardous materials and disposal correctly, with disposal reporting to the client.

**Site services**

* Plan generator removal and replacement at tower sites with the client’s operations and construction teams.
* Make sure field technicians hold the required electrical and mechanical certifications and follow site safety rules.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

* 5+ years of project or program management in field services, equipment repair, logistics or telecom infrastructure.
* 3+ years working with diesel or natural gas standby generators and automatic transfer switches (ATS).
* Working knowledge of Generac and Kohler generator platforms and their controllers.
* Experience managing a repair, refurbishment or reverse-logistics operation with testing and QA documentation.
* Inventory management experience: serialized asset tracking, cycle counts, stock levels and demand planning.
* Experience managing subcontractors and vendors, including qualification, scheduling and performance.
* Comfortable working from contract terms: POs, work orders, SLAs, warranties, title and risk of loss.
* Strong Excel skills and experience with an inventory, ERP or work order system.
* Clear written reporting to an enterprise client on a daily, weekly and monthly cadence.
* Able to work independently and remotely, and to manage on-site work from a distance.
* Valid driver’s license and a clean driving record.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* EGSA Generator Technician certification, or prior hands-on generator technician experience.
* Experience with tower or cell-site backup power programs for a national carrier or tower company.
* Background in aftermarket parts, remanufacturing or consignment and resale programs.
* Knowledge of EPA and DOT rules for fluids, batteries, hazardous materials and freight.
* Familiarity with OSHA 10/30 and site-access qualification for subcontractors.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Working conditions**
----------------------

* Based mostly on-site at our Power Solutions location in Jasper, TX.
* Travel to repair vendors and field sites, up to 40% of the time.
* Availability outside normal hours during storm response or urgent replacement orders.
* On-site visits involve warehouse and tower-site conditions: heat, noise, outdoor weather and PPE.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs and walk uneven ground at sites.

**Success measures**
--------------------

* On-time delivery and order closeout against required dates.
* Quote, order and testing turnaround within contract response times.
* Every unit and component tested, documented and serial-tracked.
* Daily, weekly and monthly client reports delivered complete and on time.
* Rising refurbishment yield and recovery value on non-functional equipment.
* Low warranty returns and zero unauthorized work.
* Invoices submitted promptly after work is accepted.

**Equal opportunity**
---------------------

Cat5 Resources is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected status. Employment may be contingent on a background check and drug screen.

Title: Senior ERP Transformation & D365 Programme Assurance Lead
Description:
Senior ERP Transformation & D365 Programme Assurance Lead

Location: Doha, Qatar

Client: Major Government Entity

Employment Type: Full-Time / Project-Based Contract

Experience: 15+ Years Preferred

Industry: Government / Public Sector

Technology: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O)

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior ERP Transformation & D365 Programme Assurance Lead to oversee and support a large-scale Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations implementation for a major government client in Qatar.

The successful candidate will take end-to-end responsibility for client-side programme governance, implementation oversight, functional and technical assurance, data migration, organisational change, testing, cutover readiness and overall delivery quality.

This is a senior, hands-on role requiring a professional who combines strong ERP programme management capabilities with practical Microsoft Dynamics 365 implementation experience.

The individual must be capable of independently assessing the implementation partner's deliverables, identifying risks, challenging solution designs, monitoring project execution and ensuring the programme meets the client's business, technical, security and operational requirements.

The position requires an experienced practitioner who can operate at both executive and technical levels, engaging with senior government stakeholders while directly reviewing implementation activities and deliverables.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take overall responsibility for client-side governance, monitoring and assurance of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP implementation.
* Establish and maintain effective programme governance, project controls, executive reporting and escalation mechanisms.
* Manage implementation schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues and contractual obligations.
* Oversee implementation partner performance and validate progress against agreed scope, quality standards and delivery commitments.
* Review and challenge functional and technical solution designs to ensure alignment with business requirements and recognised industry practices.
* Conduct fit-gap assessments and validate Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance, Supply Chain Management and Project Operations configurations.
* Ensure appropriate use of standard D365 functionality and challenge unnecessary customisations.
* Review business requirements, process mapping, functional specifications and solution architecture.
* Oversee data migration planning, source-to-target mapping, data cleansing, transformation, reconciliation and migration quality.
* Validate the use of D365 Data Management Framework (DMF), data entities and associated migration tools.
* Review mock migrations, migration reconciliation results and final data cutover readiness.
* Coordinate organisational change activities, including stakeholder engagement, business impact assessment, role mapping, communications and training.
* Review training strategies, user documentation, training delivery and business adoption readiness.
* Oversee the integrated testing lifecycle, including system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), regression testing and defect management.
* Validate test strategies, test cases, coverage, execution evidence and defect resolution.
* Manage cutover planning, implementation rehearsals, go-live readiness assessments and command-centre coordination.
* Define and monitor go/no-go criteria, rollback considerations and post-go-live stabilisation requirements.
* Review Microsoft Dynamics 365 security configurations, role-based access controls and segregation of duties (SoD).
* Assess integration with Microsoft Entra ID, Power Platform, enterprise applications and associated technical environments.
* Review application security, access governance, privileged access, integration controls, logging and audit capabilities.
* Ensure appropriate cybersecurity, data protection and information security requirements are incorporated throughout implementation.
* Identify programme risks, technical weaknesses, delivery gaps and potential non-compliance with agreed requirements.
* Provide independent quality assurance of implementation partner deliverables and formal acceptance recommendations.
* Prepare executive dashboards, progress reports, risk assessments and technical assurance findings.
* Engage directly with senior client stakeholders, steering committees, business owners and implementation partners.
* Support issue resolution, change control, contractual discussions and corrective action planning.
* Ensure the ERP solution is appropriately tested, secured, documented and operationally ready for successful deployment.

**Required Experience & Technical Competencies**

ERP Programme Management & Governance

* Minimum 15 years of experience in enterprise ERP implementation, digital transformation or complex technology programme delivery.
* Minimum 10 years of experience managing or overseeing enterprise ERP programmes.
* Direct involvement in at least two Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations implementations, preferably covering the complete implementation lifecycle.
* Proven experience managing implementation partners, contractual deliverables, programme schedules and executive stakeholders.
* Strong experience with programme governance, risk management, project controls and quality assurance.
* Ability to independently manage complex ERP implementation activities and provide credible executive-level recommendations.

**Microsoft Dynamics 365 Functional & Technical Knowledge**

* Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
* Understanding of Finance, Supply Chain Management and Project Operations functionality.
* Experience reviewing solution designs, fit-gap analysis, functional specifications and business process configurations.
* Knowledge of D365 integration architecture, Power Platform and Microsoft enterprise technology environments.
* Ability to challenge functional and technical implementation decisions.

**Data Migration & Quality Assurance**

* Experience overseeing or delivering at least two ERP data migration exercises.
* Knowledge of D365 Data Management Framework (DMF), data entities and migration methodologies.
* Strong understanding of data quality, mapping, cleansing, transformation and reconciliation.
* Experience managing migration dry runs, cutover and data validation activities.

**Testing, Cutover & Change Management**

* Demonstrated experience managing SIT, UAT, defect governance and integrated ERP testing.
* Experience coordinating production cutover planning, rehearsal and go-live activities.
* Knowledge of organisational change management, role mapping, training design and user adoption.
* Experience conducting business readiness and post-go-live stabilisation assessments

**Security & Technical Assurance**

* Strong understanding of D365 role-based security and segregation of duties.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Power Platform and enterprise application integration.
* Familiarity with application security controls, identity management, data protection and audit requirements.
* Understanding of cloud environments, security configurations and technical governance.
* Ability to assess ERP implementation security risks and recommend corrective actions

**Qualifications & Certifications**

Preferred qualifications include:

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* PMP, PgMP or PRINCE2 certification.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance or Supply Chain Management certifications.
* Relevant Microsoft Azure, Power Platform or security certifications.
* ITIL, COBIT or other recognised governance and assurance qualifications.

Equivalent practical experience on major ERP programmes will be considered.

Desirable Experience

* Previous experience delivering or assuring ERP implementations for government entities in Qatar or the GCC.
* Experience acting as a client-side ERP Programme Lead, Transformation Director or Independent Assurance Lead.
* Familiarity with public-sector finance, procurement, supply chain and project accounting requirements.
* Experience managing complex ERP implementations involving multiple systems, departments and business units.
* Experience recovering delayed or underperforming ERP programmes.
* Understanding of applicable Qatar government cybersecurity, information assurance and data governance requirements.
* Arabic language skills are advantageous.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Excellent analytical, technical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to independently assess and challenge implementation partners.
* Good understanding of contracts, budgets and project delivery.
* Strong reporting, documentation and presentation skills.
* Able to manage complex projects, priorities and risks independently.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Ensure effective ERP implementation governance and control.
* Review and validate functional and technical designs.
* Oversee data migration, system integration and security.
* Ensure user readiness, training and adoption.
* Manage testing, defects and go-live preparation.
* Verify vendor deliverables and contractual compliance.
* Provide clear progress reports, risk updates and corrective actions.
* Ensure a secure, smooth and successful ERP go-live.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a highly experienced ERP professional with strong programme leadership, Microsoft Dynamics 365 functional and technical knowledge, and hands-on implementation experience. The candidate must be able to independently assess ERP implementation activities, manage programme governance, and engage with senior stakeholders. Candidates with only project coordination, general ERP management, or single-module experience will not be considered.

Title: General Manager
Description:
Tahreez Sport & Entertainment (TSE) is a joint venture between Tahreez and PMY Group, combining Tahreez’s strong Saudi foundation, operational capabilities, and market insight with PMY’s globally recognised expertise in live environment technologies and major event delivery.

Together, TSE delivers integrated venue technologies and operational solutions that enhance safety, efficiency, and audience experiences across stadiums, arenas, and live entertainment environments throughout Saudi Arabia.

Combining deep local insight with decades of global experience, TSE provides end-to-end capabilities across strategy, consulting, design, implementation, operations, software, data intelligence, and live experience technologies.

Backed by more than 500 professionals, over 1,000 clients across 15 countries, and more than 40 years of combined industry expertise, TSE is uniquely positioned to deliver world-class venue and event technology solutions tailored to the Saudi market.

United by a shared commitment to innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence, Tahreez and PMY work together to create connected, future-ready live environments — delivering invisible technology with visible impact.

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

The General Manager – TSE will be responsible for growing and leading Tahreez Sports & Entertainment's business and operations across the Kingdom.

The role requires a commercially driven and entrepreneurial leader with a strong understanding of the Saudi market, capable of developing client relationships, converting opportunities into profitable revenue, and building and managing a growing organisation.

Working closely with the leadership of PMY Group and Tahreez, the General Manager will bring rigour, commitment and accountability to the execution of the business plan, ensuring operational excellence, financial discipline and sustainable growth.

The role will be instrumental in establishing the JV as a trusted advisor and delivery partner across sport, entertainment, venues, major events, technology and infrastructure in Saudi Arabia.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategic Leadership & Growth**

* Develop and execute the Saudi Arabia growth strategy aligned to the objectives of both PMY Group and Tahreez.
* Identify emerging market opportunities, strategic sectors, and priority clients to support long-term growth.
* Provide leadership and direction to ensure sustainable and profitable business expansion.

**Business Development & Client Relationships**

* Lead the pursuit and conversion of new business opportunities across sports, entertainment, venues, events, technology, and infrastructure sectors.
* Build and maintain executive-level relationships with clients, government entities, developers, venue operators, event owners, partners, and industry stakeholders.
* Support bid strategy, negotiations, commercial discussions, and contract execution.

**Operational Leadership**

* Oversee the successful establishment and operation of the Saudi business, ensuring appropriate governance, processes and controls are in place in alignment with Tahreez and PMY Group.
* Provide executive oversight of project delivery performance, client satisfaction, resource planning, and operational effectiveness.

**Financial Performance**

* Own the Saudi Arabia business plan, revenue targets, profitability objectives, budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance.
* Monitor business performance and implement actions to achieve growth and margin targets.
* Ensure commercial discipline, risk management, and strong financial governance across all activities.

**Joint Venture Leadership**

* Maintain a collaborative and effective partnership between PMY Group and Tahreez.
* Ensure strategic alignment between both organisations while balancing commercial, operational, and cultural objectives.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders from both JV partners.
* Support the implementation of agreed governance frameworks and reporting requirements.

**People & Culture**

* Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Saudi-based team as the business grows.
* Create a culture aligned with the values and behaviours of both PMY Group and Tahreez.
* Provide mentoring, coaching, and leadership development to employees.
* Drive employee engagement, accountability, and performance excellence.

**Stakeholder & Government Engagement**

* Develop strong relationships with key government authorities, regulatory bodies, strategic partners, and industry leaders.
* Maintain awareness of market developments, regulatory requirements, and strategic initiatives relevant to the business.
* Act as the primary representative and spokesperson for the Joint Venture within the Kingdom.
* Contribute to maintaining a safe and healthy workplace in accordance with company Occupational Health and Safety policies, operational standards, and relevant legislative requirements.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Significant senior leadership experience within Saudi Arabia or the GCC region.
* Demonstrated experience establishing, leading, or scaling a growing business operation.
* Strong commercial acumen with proven business development and client relationship management capability.
* Experience working across sports, entertainment, venues, major events, technology, infrastructure, construction, or related sectors.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage senior executives, government representatives, and strategic partners.
* Proven financial management and P&L leadership experience.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a high-growth environment.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and people management skills.
* Cultural awareness and ability to operate successfully within a joint venture environment.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction, Technology, Sports Management, or a related discipline.

**WHY TAHREEZ SPORTS AND ENTERTAINMENT?**

* **Shape the Future** Be part of a company bringing world-class venue and live environment technologies into Saudi Arabia across sports, entertainment, and major destinations.
* **Create Real Impact** Contribute to delivering intelligent technologies that enhance safety, operational efficiency, connectivity, and audience experience across the Kingdom.
* **Work Alongside Experts** Collaborate with industry professionals and global specialists across venue technologies, integrated systems, operations, and live event environments.
* **Grow With Purpose** Build your career in a dynamic sector that encourages continuous learning, professional growth, and hands-on experience on ambitious projects.
* **Be Part of Something Bigger** As a strategic joint venture between Tahreez and PMY Group, TSE combines global innovation with strong Saudi operational capability to deliver intelligent solutions with real impact.

### **Company Overview**

TRANSFORMING THROUGH TECHNOLOGY - PMY Group is a full-service technology solutions company that supports venues and major events to enhance their infrastructure, experience, and intelligence. We specialise in providing cutting-edge AI, data, and cloud solutions to sports, media, and entertainment sectors, helping them achieve their full potential through the transformative power of data and AI.

Title: Director of IT
Description:
Guru Studio is a creative-driven entertainment company and an industry leader in animated storytelling. For over twenty years, our studio has brought to life some of the most recognizable and beloved children’s properties in the world.
  
  
We’re always looking for passionate and committed talent, so come join our dynamic and growing team!
  
  
Guru is proud to offer our team members meaningful learning and developmental opportunities! You will work alongside a wide range of talent in a positive and supportive environment where we want to see success in each individual.
  
  
We're looking for a talented and experienced Director of IT - come join our team!
  
  
The Director of IT will supervise and manage the IT department’s daily and long-term operations to allow for growth in a fast paced and rapidly expanding internationally renowned animation studio. This role is a management position for a very sophisticated tech-based company and requires clear and effective leadership and visionary thinking. This role reports to the VP of Technology.
  
  
Duties and Responsibilities:
  
  
Management + Supervision
  
  

* Manage a department of IT professionals in their day to day operational functions and all of their responsibilities including server, desktop, and communications infrastructure, ensuring a reasonable level of in-studio IT support is available during regular business hours.
* Set goals and milestones for all IT staff. Review their performance and report to the VP of Technology.
* Liaise with all heads of production and business operations to ensure IT department’s efforts are coordinated to meet everyone’s needs (get information on studio upcoming projects, determine production resources needs, communication and delivery requirements and issue and follow up on all appropriate tasks).

Facility Infrastructure Planning
  
  

* Ensure all physical services (leased space, electrical, HVAC, floor load etc) at the studio and in the data centre are able to support IT equipment and services and that the equipment is compatible and fully integrated with physical services.
* Manage all budget needs for the IT department: create, present and revise purchase orders, follow up on approvals, ensure purchasing documentation is digitized, recorded and stored in a central repository, maintain IT inventory lists.
* Budget for, acquire and maintain appropriate licenses for all software needed for production and business operations.
* Maintain studio growth plan with the President, the VP of Technology and VP of Finance and Business Affairs.
* Gather and organize purchasing research with guidance from relevant IT personnel.
* Prepare projected equipment cost information for studio project bidding purposes.
* Implement, manage and supervise IT desktop ticketing systems.
* Schedule IT all operations including: personnel, technical maintenance, internal meetings and finance and budget related deadlines.
* Ensure regular maintenance and upgrades are done to all IT infrastructure to ensure a secure and well-functioning IT environment.
* Work with studio stakeholders to implement any studio expansion or move.

Knowledgebase
  
  

* Maintain IT documentation/wiki (oversee, coordinate and arrange information input and creation of diagrams, organize the structure of documentation/wiki, propose new sections).
* Create and Maintain IT procedures and policies (coordinate with the input from the VP of Technology).
* Guru methodology asks for employees who will go above and beyond; in staying informed on upcoming technologies, most cost-effective vendors and taking the initiative in implementing forward thinking planning within each department.

Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5+ years of progressive experience in IT infrastructure and operations, including 1–2+ years in a senior management or director-level role.

**Regional Director**

* Facility Management Office roles to support accounts,

****KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES****
**Health, Safety, Environment & Security**

* Accountable for meeting all internal and external health, safety, environment and security-related requirements
* Accountable for the safe delivery of all work performed

**Account Management**
  
  

* Continuously engages clients in discussions to understand and anticipate needs, identify and recommend additional services

**Client Relationship Management**
  
  

* Accountable for achieving client satisfaction objectives for the assigned region(s)
* Accountable for developing and maintaining effective relationships with clients, managing client expectations
* Position level of client representatives with whom this position typically interacts with include those at the senior management level
* Acts as the focal point of escalation for issues pertaining to facilities within assigned region(s)

**Region/Portfolio Budget Development & Management**
  
  

* Assume financial responsibility for facility operations, including budget management.
* In partnership with finance, responsible for the development of budgets (O&M, Transaction, capital projects and rent), and be able to support and explain approach to the client and the account team.
* Using financial reports, perform monthly budget, analyze and re-forecast allocations as necessary.
* Meet annual targets as per contractual performance and client financial targets / indicators.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and develop strategies to maximize financial resources.
* Track and report on budget positive or negative trends performance regularly
* Participates in, provides recommendations, and contributes to continuous improvement projects to achieve efficiency gains and cost savings

**Portfolio Management**
  
  

* Accountable for operations management for the portfolio of facilities within the assigned region(s)
* Leads the operations and maintenance activities of a portfolio of facilities along with the execution of the portfolio’s programs
* Oversees the completion and submission of capital plans
* Creates and implements short to mid-term plans for the assigned region(s)
* Provides input into strategic plans
* Collaborates with relevant stakeholders to optimize facilities within assigned region(s) and continuously create value for the client.

**Service Delivery Management**

* Monitor work order progress and ensure tasks are completed within established timelines.
* Work with Account Governance Teams to maintain accurate records of work orders and associated costs.
* Streamline and manage work order processes to optimize efficiency.
* Prioritize and assign work orders based on urgency and impact on facility operations.
* Accountable for meeting all service obligations for the assigned region(s)
* Oversees the delivery of all service obligations
* Accountable for meeting established metrics/key performance indicators.  Leads the operations team in the development and implementation of action plans to remediate gaps, where applicable, to ensure objectives are met.
* Accountable for ensuring compliance to all legislated, corporate and industry-related requirements and guidelines including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, and building standard requirements

**Risk Management, Emergency Preparedness and Business Continuity Planning and Execution**
  
  

* Accountable for safeguarding the client against emergencies and risks by ensuring emergency preparedness, risk management, disaster recovery and business continuity plans are developed and that relevant stakeholders are trained to ensure proper execution
* Oversight and engagement in Emergency Management

**Regulatory Compliance**
  
  

* Accountable for ensuring all regulatory compliance requirements have been met and all related documentation are created and maintained
* Ensure compliance with corporate and legislated policies, procedures, practices and guidelines related to environmental, building code and issues by applying cursory knowledge of legislation related to these areas

**Project Management**
  
  

* Accountable for on-time, on-budget and quality delivery of facility management projects for the assigned region(s)
* Collaborates with clients and internal stakeholders to identify project opportunities and priorities, develop and implement projects
* Oversees the development and execution of project plans for portfolios within assigned region(s)

**Procurement**
  
  

* With Support from BGIS Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management Leadership – follow BGIS Vendor Performance and Relationship Management Program protocols
* Collaborates with Procurement and Supply Chain Administration teams to source and qualify vendors, source and procure goods and services.

**Continuous Improvement**
  
  

* Collaborates with stakeholders and contributes to efficiency gains   through activities including but not limited to identifying and implementing best practices; reviewing, refining and/or developing, implementing processes, technologies and sustainable practices, and leveraging self-perform wherever possible.  Implements related enhancements for the assigned region(s)

**Leadership and Recognition**
  
  

* Accountable for employee-oriented activities including but not limited to employee engagement, development and performance management, hiring and retention, compensation recommendations
* Employee Satisfaction Scores and employee recognition (development and implementation of action plans to improve ESAT scores)
* Day to day support and team oversight/management

**Collaboration with BGIS Self Perform Teams delivering Best Quality Services to Buildings**
  
  

* Work in collaboration with BGIS teams in Janitorial, Project Management and TechnicalServices or any other areas where work is directly performed by BGIS to maximize efficiency and the best customer service in the buildings / portfolios
* Work together with these teams to ensure work is completed

**Technology to Support your Success.**
  
  

* Leverage technology such as work order system, vendor monitoring tools, BAS and CMMS scheduling tools to deliver effective service to clients.
* Mentor staff in vendor management and the effective use of technology for vendor relationships.
* Provide guidance to team members on the effective use of technology for financial management and career progression.
* Other duties as assigned

****KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS****

* Community college diploma preferably in business administration
* More than 10 years of facility management work experience
* Highly skilled at account management
* Highly skilled at facility operations management
* Highly skilled at client relationship management with demonstrated ability in building and managing relationships with client representatives at the senior management level
* Highly skilled at managing service delivery and meeting service delivery obligations
* Skilled at managing budgets
* Fully developed communication, influence, persuasion and negotiation skills
* High degree of client service orientation and sense of urgency
* Highly skilled at leading and engaging a team of individuals
* Skilled at vendor management
* Highly skilled at emergency management, emergency preparedness and business continuity planning and execution
* Possesses a sustainability mindset and seeks to incorporate sustainable practices within assigned portfolio where possible
* Expert level knowledge of health and safety requirements. Possesses a high degree of safety mindset
* Maintains current knowledge of and highly skilled at implementing facility management services best practices
* Expert level knowledge of current building standards and requirements
* Possesses a continuous improvement and quality mindset along with a desire to continuously seek and incorporate innovative practices and technologies in order to deliver value to the client

* Certified Facility Manager from International Facility Management Association

Title: Senior Manager, Specialty Operations (Remote)
Description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Manager of Specialty Operations to support the operational execution of our new specialty product launch. This role will be responsible for overseeing the day-to-day execution of specialty distribution, specialty pharmacy, and patient support operations for a rare disease product, with an initial focus on the successful commercialization of the new product launch. The role will also collaborate closely with Account Managers, Field Reimbursement Managers, and other internal stakeholders to resolve complex issues, improve processes, and ensure a seamless patient and provider experience.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Specialty Distribution Partner Management:**

* Support day-to-day operational execution across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services, ensuring coordination with internal teams and timely escalation of operational barriers.Partner with vendor program managers across specialty pharmacy and specialty distribution services to support operational activities, monitor open issues, and facilitate timely issue resolution and follow-up actions.

* Monitor and maintain operational performance standards with specialty distribution partners, ensuring alignment with agreed-upon service levels, KPIs, and regulatory requirements.

* Coordinate resolution of operational barriers involving prescription processing, medical benefit reimbursement, buy-and-bill, institutional procurement, billing and claims, and alignment of product delivery with treatment scheduling, engaging appropriate functional experts as needed. Create and manage various channel/SD/SP communications and documents

* Work closely with the Channel Operations team to monitor/maintain optimal inventory levels.

* Support the maintenance, implementation, and periodic review of established business rules and operational procedures with specialty distribution partners.

* Contribute to development of product and channel specific contract strategies

  
  

**Collaboration with Internal Stakeholders:**

* Coordinate operational activities across the vendor program manager, Access Strategy, Patient Services, Trade & Distribution, Data & Analytics, and field leadership.

* Maintain documented responsibilities and handoffs, and route strategic, policy, and customer-facing decisions to the accountable function. Work cross-functionally with Market Access on product access issues and Medical team on resource development and pull-through.

* Develop relationships and work closely with the Patient Services team and/or Field Reimbursement Managers to help resolve patient/ provider access issues.

* Provide regular updates regarding partner performance, patient access issues, and any operational challenges, continuously evolving/challenging our support model with learnings related to medical/pharmacy benefit coverage learnings

* Collaborate with the team to continuously improve patient services and operational processes, including reviewing and optimizing workflows to enhance the overall customer experience.

  
  

**Issue Investigation & Resolution:**

* Take ownership of investigating operational issues and work with internal and external teams to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.

* Address challenges related to patient enrollment, medication distribution, insurance verification, or other issues impacting pharmacy operations.

* Escalate critical issues as needed and ensure effective communication with all relevant parties to resolve problems quickly and efficiently.

  
  

**Reporting & Data Analysis:**

* Identify appropriate metrics and tracking to ensure the right execution and success; analyze procedure volume, trends and growth for the specialty channel.

* Compile operational metrics, document performance trends, and provide reporting support for management reviews and business update meetings. Provide regular reports on operational performance, issue resolution, and process improvements to the Director of Specialty Operations.

* Analyze specialty reporting and work with data and analytics team to create patient, provider, physician, pharmacy and payer data dashboards in order to help improve processes

* Monitor specialty distributor/pharmacy data (ie; Time to First Fill, Conversion Rate, Gap days and Adherence)

  
  

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Participate in regular process improvement initiatives aimed at optimizing specialty distribution network operations and enhancing the patient experience.

* Provide input into the development and refinement of training materials, operational procedures, and best practices for working with specialty pharmacy partners.

  
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree from an accredited four-year college or university.

* Minimum 3–5 years of relevant pharmaceutical industry experience, including hands-on management of specialty partner operations, patient services, and complex access workflows. Demonstrated experience coordinating hub, specialty pharmacy, and specialty distribution services and managing vendor performance is required.

* Experience with medical benefit therapies, institutional delivery, and launch implementation is preferred.

* Experience evaluating data sources for insights, specifically specialty distribution and patient services data.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate the data management subject matter to a non-technical/unfamiliar internal customer.

* Pharmacy experience preferred

**Competencies**  
**Accountability for Results -** Stay focused on key strategic objectives, be accountable for high standards of performance, and take an active role in leading change.
  
**Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving -** Make decisions considering the long-term impact to customers, patients, employees, and the business.
  
**Patient & Customer Centricity -** Maintain an ongoing focus on the needs of our customers and/or key stakeholders.
  
**Impactful Communication -** Communicate with logic, clarity, and respect. Influence at all levels to achieve the best results for Otsuka.
  
**Respectful Collaboration -** Seek and value others’ perspectives and strive for diverse partnerships to enhance work toward common goals.
  
**Empowered Development -** Play an active role in professional development as a business imperative.

***Get to know the role***

* Job Title: Technical Program Manager
* Job Summary: The Technical Program Manager leads the program and project portfolio that advances IT Infrastructure & Services priorities, service maturity, and organizational capabilities. This role connects strategy to execution by turning business and technology priorities into an integrated roadmap, establishing the mechanisms needed to evaluate demand and sequence work, and providing leaders with clear information about business value, dependencies, risks, capacity, and decisions.This is an individual contributor role with accountability for portfolio governance, demand management, cross-functional alignment, and delivery of complex technology programs. The Technical Program Manager works through influence across technical teams and business stakeholders, partners with Operational Excellence to support broader Technology portfolio visibility, enables consistent execution across Project Managers and technical leaders, and directly leads selected high-priority or cross-departmental initiatives. Success will be measured by the clarity of portfolio decisions, alignment of stakeholders and resources, and business outcomes delivered through the program.

***What you'll do***

**Turn strategy into an executable program and portfolio**

* Own the integrated program and project portfolio for IT Infrastructure & Services, connecting related initiatives to service, capability, and business outcomes.
* Translate strategic priorities into roadmaps, sequenced initiatives, decision points, and clear ownership across delivery teams.
* Maintain a decision-ready view of portfolio health, business value, dependencies, risks, capacity constraints, resource needs, and expected outcomes.
* Provide practical recommendations and facilitate tradeoff decisions so leaders can prioritize investment and focus limited capacity on the highest-value work.

**Create disciplined demand, intake, and prioritization practices**

* Coordinate the intake and evaluation of proposed initiatives, ensuring requests have clear outcomes, sponsorship, scope, dependencies, risks, and resource implications.

* Anticipate and manage cross-project dependencies, resource conflicts, risks, and decisions that could affect outcomes or timelines.
* Keep stakeholders aligned on commitments, tradeoffs, progress, and expected business outcomes while adapting plans as priorities and conditions change.

* Strong facilitation, negotiation, conflict-resolution, and stakeholder-management skills.

Title: Sr. Manager EPM Platform (OneStream)
Description:
**The Opportunity**

The Sr. Manager of EPM Platform is a people-leadership role accountable for the governance, change management, and controls posture of the organization's EPM platforms, leading a team of two EPM Administrators covering OneStream, the organization's new EPM platform, and Hyperion, the legacy platform. Acting as the primary point of accountability between the business, the EPM Administrators, and third-party MSO consultants, the Manager quarterbacks all incoming requests from intake through resolution — triaging priority and complexity, assigning the right resource, and ensuring work is delivered within a disciplined change management and controls framework. The role also owns the Hyperion transition: Hyperion will stop receiving operational updates after December 2026, though system access will continue beyond that date. This role establishes and enforces the protocols that protect the integrity, security, and auditability of the EPM environment, while ensuring the business experiences a single, well-managed front door for EPM platform needs.

**Key Accountabilities**

***Business Request Intake & Triage***

* Serve as the single point of accountability and “quarterback” for all OneStream-related requests coming in from the business.
* Triage incoming requests for priority, complexity, and risk, and determine the appropriate resourcing path — the EPM Administrators, third-party MSO consultants, or a combination of both.
* Engage directly with business stakeholders to clarify scope, gather requirements, set expectations, and provide status updates through to resolution.
* Act as the day-to-day relationship owner with third-party MSO consultants, directing their work, reviewing deliverables, and holding them accountable to timelines and quality standards.
* Reinforce EPM as the mandatory first point of contact for all OneStream requests, redirecting stakeholders who attempt to bypass the intake process.
* Escalate complex, cross-functional, or resourcing conflicts to the Sr. Director, Data & Analytics with clear recommendations.

***Change Management***

* Own and continuously improve the change management framework for the OneStream platform, covering configuration, security, integrations, and reporting/planning logic.
* Establish and enforce a formal change intake, approval, and sign-off process, including documentation standards and required approvals prior to promotion to production.
* Assess and document the business, technical, and risk impact of proposed changes before implementation.
* Maintain a complete, auditable change log/register for the OneStream environment.
* Plan and coordinate release and deployment schedules to minimize disruption during peak business cycles (month-end, quarter-end, budget, and forecast).

***Governance, Controls & Compliance***

* Design, implement, and enforce governance protocols and standard operating procedures for OneStream administration and system change.
* Define, monitor, and enforce security, access, and segregation-of-duties controls in partnership with the EPM Administrators.
* Ensure OneStream administration and change activity meet internal controls, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead periodic reviews/audits of system configuration, user access, and change history, and remediate gaps.
* Own and maintain governance documentation, including policies, procedures, RACI, and control frameworks for the EPM environment.

***Platform & Vendor Oversight***

* Manage the ongoing relationship with third-party MSO consultants, directing their work and holding them accountable to timelines, deliverable quality, and scope.
* Oversee Testing/QA and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) cycles for OneStream releases, ensuring they follow the established change management protocol.
* Ensure system and control documentation remains current and reflects the live-state configuration of the platform.

***People Leadership:***

* Directly manage the two EPM Administrators (OneStream and Hyperion), including workload planning, performance management, coaching, and professional development.
* Own the Hyperion end-of-life transition plan, coordinating accessibility and operational update cut-off ahead of the end-of-2026 sunset date with stakeholders.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop EPM Administrator talent, and foster teamwork and knowledge-sharing across the OneStream and Hyperion functions.

Department Leadership (as applicable)

* Own budgetary and financial oversight of third-party MSO consultant spend, including statements of work, invoice/effort accuracy, and OneStream licensing costs, in partnership with the Sr. Director, Data & Analytics.

**Qualifications**

***Education:***

* Post-secondary Diploma or University Degree in Computer Science, Accounting/Finance, Business, or a related discipline.
* OneStream certification (Administrator or Design) is strongly preferred.
* Accounting and financial knowledge is a strong asset, given the controls and compliance focus of the role.

***Experience:***

* 5-7+ years of experience in EPM/financial systems administration, IT governance, or systems delivery, including hands-on OneStream experience (Hyperion or comparable EPM platform experience considered).
* Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, or enforcing change management processes for enterprise systems.
* Experience designing or enforcing IT governance, controls, or compliance protocols; SOX or internal audit experience is an asset.
* Experience triaging and managing incoming business requests, and translating business needs into scoped technical work.
* Experience managing third-party vendors, managed service providers, or consultants, including SOWs, deliverables, and performance accountability.
* Experience acting as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams; prior direct people-management experience, including performance management and coaching, is preferred.

***Skills & Abilities:***

* Strong understanding of change management practice and IT general controls (ITGCs) as applied to enterprise/financial systems, and working knowledge of OneStream functionality (consolidation, reporting, planning, security) sufficient to triage and validate technical requests without requiring deep hands-on administration.
* OneStream – Advanced; Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint – Advanced.
* Confident, credible stakeholder management with the ability to set expectations and manage competing priorities.
* Skilled at directing and holding external consultants/MSOs accountable to scope, timelines, and quality.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to present technical and control concepts to varied audiences and enforce protocols diplomatically but firmly.
Sound judgment in assessing urgency, impact, and risk to sequence competing requests.  

**Effort**

Primarily mental effort: sustained concentration and attention to detail when reviewing system configurations, change requests, and audit/control documentation; extended periods viewing a computer screen while validating OneStream/Hyperion data, coordinating releases, and managing competing priorities across the team and business stakeholders. Physical effort is typical of an office role, involving sitting, keyboarding, and occasional walking within the office environment.

**Working Conditions**

Work is generally performed in an office environment at the Corporate Office in Mississauga, with the following considerations:

* Availability to work non-standard hours and flexibility concerning workdays.
* Irregular work hours required during peak periods such as month-end, quarter-end, and budget/forecast cycles.
