Title: IT Director of Operations
Description:
**Job Summary**
Reporting to the VP of Infrastructure, the IT Director of Operations provides strategic and operational leadership for the organization's Service Desk, Field Services, IT Service Management, Change Control, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, service request fulfillment, and end-user support functions. This role is accountable for delivering reliable, responsive, secure, and consistent technology support to corporate offices, service centers, remote workers, and operating locations.
  
  
The Director establishes a customer-focused operating model, develops high-performing support teams, improves service quality through standardization and automation, and ensures operational processes produce measurable improvements in user experience, service availability, response time, resolution time, change success, and cost efficiency. The position partners closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Information Security, Enterprise Applications, Clinical Applications, Human Resources, Compliance, Finance, vendors, and business leaders, and serves as a senior leader during major incidents and high-risk changes.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Provide leadership, direction, and accountability for Service Desk, Field Services, IT Service Management, Change Control, Major Incident Management, Problem Management, and related operational support functions, including organizational design, workforce planning, recruiting, coaching, succession planning, performance management, and professional development.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year IT operations strategy and service improvement roadmap aligned with business growth, acquisitions, technology modernization, cybersecurity requirements, financial objectives, employee experience, and operational risk tolerance.
* Own the Service Desk operating model, including intake channels, call handling, ticket triage, prioritization, escalation, request fulfillment, knowledge management, shift coverage, quality assurance, customer communications, and service-level performance.
* Lead Field Services and deskside support across distributed locations, including onsite incident resolution, device deployment and recovery, site support, technology readiness for openings and relocations, executive support, inventory coordination, and local vendor management.
* Own IT service management practices and governance, including incident, request, major incident, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, configuration, and continual improvement processes, using ITIL-aligned practices and clearly defined ownership, controls, and measures.
* Lead enterprise Change Control and the Change Advisory Board process. Establish risk and impact criteria, approval thresholds, peer and technical review requirements, testing expectations, implementation and rollback standards, maintenance-window governance, emergency change controls, post-implementation validation, and reporting.
* Serve as the senior operational leader for major technology incidents. Ensure rapid business-impact assessment, clear command and escalation structures, timely stakeholder communications, cross-team coordination, service restoration, executive updates, after-action reviews, root-cause analysis, and completion of corrective actions.
* Establish problem management practices that identify recurring incidents and service degradation, prioritize root-cause investigation, assign accountable owners, track known errors and workarounds, and verify that permanent corrective actions reduce repeat demand.
* Build and govern a usable service catalog, supported by defined services, request offerings, ownership, fulfillment workflows, service targets, knowledge articles, and customer-facing expectations.
* Improve employee technology experience through self-service, automation, shift-left support, remote-support tools, standardized knowledge, proactive communications, customer feedback, and reduction of avoidable contacts and repeat incidents.
* Partner with engineering, security, and application teams to establish effective operational handoffs, support readiness, monitoring and alert response, escalation paths, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria before new or changed services enter production.
* Ensure effective joiner, mover, and leaver support in coordination with Human Resources, Identity and Access Management, Security, and business leaders, including equipment, access requests, onboarding readiness, transfers, and timely recovery of company assets.
* Establish asset and endpoint support controls, including device inventory accuracy, stock and depot processes, warranty and repair coordination, refresh planning, secure disposal, loaner equipment, peripheral standards, and accountability for equipment assigned to users and locations.
* Define and report meaningful operational metrics, including contact volume, abandonment rate, speed to answer, first contact resolution, response and resolution attainment, mean time to restore, backlog age, reopen rate, escalation rate, customer satisfaction, change success rate, emergency change rate, incident recurrence, field dispatch performance, and cost per contact.
* Use performance data, customer feedback, quality reviews, trend analysis, and process audits to identify service gaps, prioritize improvements, and hold teams accountable for measurable outcomes rather than activity alone.
* Manage operating budgets, forecasts, staffing models, contracts, licensing, support tools, managed-service providers, hardware support partners, and vendor performance. Identify opportunities to reduce total cost of ownership without creating unacceptable service, security, compliance, or resilience risk.
* Lead operational due diligence and integration for acquisitions, divestitures, new locations, relocations, and major business initiatives, including support discovery, staffing impacts, device and asset planning, service onboarding, cutover support, communications, and stabilization.
* Ensure operational services comply with company policies, contractual requirements, data-protection obligations, records requirements, and healthcare-related security and privacy requirements, including HIPAA where applicable.
* Communicate service performance, customer-impacting risks, staffing needs, process maturity, investment priorities, and improvement progress clearly to technical teams, business leaders, executive leadership, auditors, and other stakeholders.
* Perform other job-related duties as assigned and provide hands-on operational leadership when business-critical conditions require it.

*The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. The employee may be asked to perform other job-related duties consistent with the role.*
**Job Requirements**
**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Management, Computer Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
* Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT service delivery, service desk, field services, or technology operations, including at least five years leading technical teams or managers in a complex, multi-site enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading Service Desk, Field Services, IT service management, change enablement, major incident management, problem management, and service improvement functions.
* Experience establishing service levels, operating procedures, quality controls, staffing models, escalation structures, knowledge management, service catalogs, and performance reporting.
* Experience with enterprise IT service management platforms such as ServiceNow, Zendesk, Jira Service Management, BMC Helix, or comparable tools, including workflow, reporting, knowledge, and self-service capabilities.
* Experience managing operating budgets, strategic vendors, managed-service providers, and distributed support delivery. Experience in healthcare, home health, hospice, post-acute care, or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting acquisitions, site openings or relocations, large technology deployments, endpoint refreshes, organizational change, and critical-incident response is preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Strong working knowledge of ITIL-aligned incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, service catalog, major incident, configuration, and continual improvement practices.
* Strong knowledge of service desk and field support operations, including call and ticket workflows, prioritization, escalation, workforce planning, queue management, remote support, deskside support, asset handling, and customer communications.

* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows endpoints, Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, collaboration tools, endpoint security, remote-support technologies, identity and access processes, and common enterprise support dependencies.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret service metrics, identify demand and failure patterns, distinguish activity from outcomes, and translate data into staffing, process, automation, and investment decisions.
* Proven ability to improve customer experience while balancing service quality, security, compliance, standardization, speed, cost, and operational risk.

* Ability to participate in after-hours escalation as needed, support planned maintenance or deployment windows, and travel to company locations based on business needs.
* Relevant certifications such as ITIL 4 Managing Professional, HDI Support Center Manager, HDI Support Center Director, Certified Change Management Professional, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or comparable credentials are preferred, not required.

Title: Enterprise Program Manager (ELM)
Description:

At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI-native Platform of Action.  
  
Over 55K legal professionals and 450+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud-based technology, configurable AI-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.

**About the Role**  
Litify is looking for a seasoned and strategic Enterprise Program Manager to lead our most critical, high value customer implementation projects for the Enterprise Legal Management product suite. This role will become an expert on our ELM product and focus on the full services lifecycle, from pre-sales (involved in scoping and approving SOWs), through implementation (implementation partner management, timeline management, risk mitigation and management) and successful go-live and hand-off.

This role serves as the central point of coordination between enterprise customers, Litify internal teams, and implementation partners to ensure successful, on-time, and high-quality deployments. You will manage program governance, delivery health, and stakeholder alignment while driving outcomes that accelerate customer value and strengthen Litify's partner ecosystem.

**The Enterprise Program Manager is responsible for the following:**

* Be the SME in Enterprise Legal Management product implementations at Litify
* AI forward thinker who can implement AI best practices in a complex enterprise projects
* Oversee and own end-to-end implementation projects in partnership with Service Implementation partners to ensure project success and drive on-time delivery
* Collaborate with the Product team on roadmaps and release plans and align with strategic objectives and priorities and educating both the Litify internal teams and the 3rd party partners running implementations
* Evaluate project team performance on individual projects and work to ensure that implementation teams have the tools, processes, and training required to deliver high quality implementations
* Identify issues and risk and ensure mitigation plans are defined or escalate as needed
* Design, pilot, and roll out new processes, best practices, standards, and KPIs as needed to improve team efficiency and effectiveness while avoiding unnecessary duplication of/variation from standard processes
* Evaluate team agile development practices, identify opportunities for improvement, and execute a visible plan for their achievement
* Own day-to-day communications with partners on project performance and progress
* Own process improvement in customer implementation cost reductions
* Own introduction of AI to enhance implementation processes.
* Own process improvement for pre-sales, implementation and partner onboarding and certification

**A successful Enterprise Program Manager will exhibit the following:**

* Strong knowledge and understanding of the corporate legal operations
* Business and growth experience to work with implementation partners
* Demonstrated experience in program management and managing multiple projects with varying timelines, scope, budget, etc. concurrently
* Collaborative, flexible, cross-functional nature with an extreme ownership mindset
* Passion for winning and raising the bar in everything you do
* Expert use of project planning and tracking tools
* Ability to influence others even when you do not have direct authority over them

Disclosure:  
The estimated base salary pay range for this role is $140,000-155,000. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

Title: Senior Manager, Data Protection & Forensics
Description:
**What you'll bring:**

* 7+ years in information security, with hands-on time in both data protection (DLP, classification, DSPM, or insider risk) and digital forensics or incident response.
* 2+ years leading people.
* Hands-on administration of an enterprise DLP platform at scale. You've written the policies and tuned out the noise yourself.
* Working command of forensic acquisition and analysis for disk, memory, mobile, and cloud, plus chain-of-custody practice.
* Experience running eDiscovery collections and legal holds and working investigations with HR and Legal under privilege.
* Scripting in Python or PowerShell, and experience with SOAR or workflow automation.
* Working knowledge of NIST CSF 2.0 and the data rules that apply to a public company: PCI DSS, CMMC, state privacy laws, and SEC cybersecurity disclosure.
* Sound judgment and discretion. You'll handle sensitive material and personnel matters, and you'll make calls on incomplete facts.
* Clear writing and briefing for executives and counsel.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Preferred: CISSP; GCFA, GCFE, GCFR, or EnCE. CIPP/US or CIPT is a plus.
* Experience in a multi-company or M&A integration environment is a plus.

  
  

**What you'll do:**

* Own the enterprise data loss prevention (DLP) platform end to end: architecture, administration, policy design, tuning, and alert triage across endpoint, email, web, cloud, and SaaS.
* Build and run data discovery and classification so we know where customer, employee, financial, and payment data lives across a multi-cloud environment.
* Run data security posture management. Find overexposed, stale, and redundant data, and remove access people don't need.
* Bring each acquired company's data under the same controls on a defined timeline as part of M&A integration.
* Extend DLP and investigations to generative AI, covering what data goes into AI tools and how prompts and outputs are preserved as evidence.
* Run the insider risk program from signal to closed case, working with HR, Legal, Privacy, and Employee Relations.
* Lead digital forensic examinations across Windows, macOS, Linux, mobile devices, cloud workloads, and collaboration platforms, from collection and preservation through analysis and reporting.
* Own evidence handling and chain of custody to a standard that holds up in litigation, regulatory inquiry, and law enforcement referral.
* Bring forensic depth to every major incident: scope, root cause, and deliver the evidence that feeds materiality decisions and after-action reports.
* Run eDiscovery collections and legal holds for Legal and outside counsel and manage forensic and eDiscovery firms when a matter needs outside support.
* Brief executives, Legal, and HR on findings in plain language.
* Lead and grow a small team of data security analysts. Hire well, coach hard, and set the bar.
* Automate first. Build playbooks that triage DLP alerts, enrich cases, and close low-risk volume without a human in the loop.
* Write and maintain the data protection and forensics standards, procedures, and runbooks, mapped to NIST CSF 2.0.
* Report metrics that show risk improvements: policy coverage, true-positive rate, time to triage, case cycle time, and sensitive-data exposure trend.
* Partner with IT, Data & Analytics, Engineering, and Legal to put controls in place without slowing the business down.

**What you'll earn:**

* 401(k) with employer match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* PTO, company holidays, and parental leave
* Paid training and certifications
* Legal assistance and identity protection
* Pet insurance
* Employee assistance program (EAP)

Title: BUSINESS MANAGER / BOOKKEEPER
Description:
NOW HIRING: BUSINESS MANAGER / BOOKKEEPER

**Kabuki Hawaii – Aiea, Oahu**

**Full-Time | $65,000–$75,000 Annually**

Kabuki Hawaii is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and detail-oriented **Business Manager / Bookkeeper** to oversee our financial reporting, bookkeeping, inventory purchasing, cash management, and daily business administration.

We are looking for someone who does more than enter numbers into QuickBooks. We need a proactive individual who understands business finances, identifies potential problems, takes ownership of responsibilities, and helps improve profitability.

This is a hands-on management position requiring strong accounting skills, organizational abilities, and the ability to work independently.

Primary Responsibilities1. Daily Financial Reporting & Profitability

**Our highest priority is having accurate, current financial information that tells ownership how the business is performing.**

* Maintain a shared Google Spreadsheet updated daily.
* Track Yesterday, Week-to-Date, and Month-to-Date financial performance.
* Monitor gross sales, net sales, and sales by category.
* Track labor costs, labor percentages, food costs, and prime costs.
* Calculate estimated operating profitability.
* Compare sales against previous periods and identify trends.
* Monitor expenses, discounts, refunds, and unusual transactions.
* Analyze daily item-by-item sales to identify best-selling and slow-moving products.
* Identify negative financial trends and notify ownership of potential problems.
* Provide clear, accurate information that helps ownership make informed business decisions.

**We expect someone who can explain what the numbers mean—not simply report them.**

2. Inventory Management & Purchasing

**Ensure the kitchen has everything necessary to prepare our menu and operate efficiently every day.**

* Oversee inventory levels and purchasing.
* Coordinate ordering of food, ingredients, beverages, packaging, and operating supplies.
* Work with kitchen management to anticipate daily production requirements.
* Ensure orders are placed accurately and on time.
* Monitor vendor pricing and identify unnecessary cost increases.
* Verify deliveries, invoices, shortages, and credits.
* Help reduce food waste, spoilage, overordering, and unnecessary expenses.
* Coordinate purchasing for catering orders, holidays, promotions, and special events.

3. Cash Management & Daily Reconciliation

* Reconcile daily cash and POS transactions.
* Verify cash receipts against register reports.
* Prepare and coordinate bank deposits.
* Maintain accurate cash records and investigate discrepancies.
* Prepare starting cash for two registers each business day.
* Calculate, document, and coordinate employee tip distributions according to Company policy and applicable law.
* Identify and promptly report cash shortages, overages, or irregularities.

Additional Responsibilities: Bookkeeping & Accounting Administration

* Maintain accurate and current QuickBooks records.
* Enter and categorize expenses, purchases, vendor invoices, and payments.
* Reconcile bank accounts, credit-card transactions, and merchant deposits.
* Maintain organized receipts, invoices, statements, and financial documentation.
* Monitor accounts payable, upcoming bills, and outstanding balances.
* Review vendor invoices for accuracy and resolve discrepancies.
* Assist with month-end financial reporting and reconciliation.
* Coordinate with the Company's accountant or CPA.
* Prepare financial information and reports requested by ownership.

Payroll & Human Resources Administration

* Coordinate employee payroll and time records.
* Maintain employee files and onboarding documentation.
* Assist with employee benefits and medical insurance administration.
* Coordinate unemployment and workers' compensation documentation.
* Maintain accurate payroll and personnel records.
* Assist management with employee-related administrative matters.

Business Operations & Administration

* Monitor business permits, licenses, insurance renewals, and important deadlines.
* Coordinate with vendors, contractors, service providers, and government agencies.
* Obtain quotes and assist with purchasing decisions.
* Track maintenance, repairs, and outstanding projects.
* Assist with catering administration and special-event coordination.
* Maintain organized business records and documentation.
* Follow through on assigned projects and responsibilities.
* Provide administrative and operational support to ownership.
* Perform other reasonable business-management responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications

**Required:**

* Strong bookkeeping and financial-management experience.
* Proficiency with QuickBooks.
* Strong Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience with accounts payable, bank reconciliations, and financial reporting.
* Ability to understand and analyze business profitability.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines.
* High level of honesty, integrity, confidentiality, and accountability.

**Preferred:**

* Restaurant, hospitality, or food-service management experience.
* Experience monitoring restaurant food costs, labor percentages, and prime costs.
* Inventory management and purchasing experience.
* Payroll and HR administration experience.
* Experience working directly with business owners or senior management.

What We're Looking For

We want someone who takes ownership of their work and understands that accurate financial information is essential to running a business.

Pay: $65,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Title: Facilities Manager
Description:
4040 Fox Street Apartments is seeking an experienced, proactive, and hands-on Facilities Manager to oversee the maintenance, operation, and overall upkeep of our luxury apartment community.

The Facilities Manager is responsible for ensuring that all building systems, apartment homes, common areas, amenities, and grounds are properly maintained and operating efficiently. This position combines technical maintenance expertise with team leadership, preventative maintenance planning, vendor coordination, and day-to-day facilities management.

The ideal candidate is a strong problem solver who takes ownership of the property's physical condition, anticipates maintenance needs, and works closely with the General Manager to ensure the community consistently meets our standards for safety, appearance, functionality, and resident satisfaction.

While this is a management position, it is also a hands-on role requiring active participation in maintenance operations, repairs, inspections, and troubleshooting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Facilities Operations & Building Maintenance**

* Oversee the daily maintenance and operation of the property's building systems, apartment homes, common areas, amenities, parking garage, and grounds.
* Ensure all plumbing, electrical, HVAC, mechanical, and other building systems are operating safely and efficiently.
* Diagnose and assist with resolving complex maintenance issues, equipment failures, and recurring building problems.
* Perform hands-on maintenance and repairs as needed to support daily operations.
* Oversee the upkeep and functionality of the pool deck, fitness center, sky deck, lounges, coworking spaces, elevators, garage equipment, and other amenities.
* Conduct regular property inspections to identify maintenance concerns, safety hazards, and areas requiring attention.
* Coordinate necessary repairs and maintenance for elevators, access control systems, garage doors, life-safety systems, and other specialized building equipment through qualified vendors.
* Ensure the property maintains a clean, safe, functional, and attractive environment for residents and visitors.

**Preventative Maintenance & Building Systems**

* Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive preventative maintenance program for building equipment, systems, and facilities.
* Establish and monitor routine inspection and maintenance schedules.
* Maintain records of equipment servicing, repairs, warranties, inspections, and vendor maintenance.
* Monitor the performance and condition of building systems and recommend repairs, replacements, or improvements when necessary.
* Identify potential equipment failures and take proactive measures to minimize downtime and costly repairs.
* Coordinate required inspections, testing, and maintenance of fire protection, life-safety, elevator, and other regulated building systems.
* Ensure maintenance operations follow applicable safety standards, manufacturer requirements, and local regulations.

**Maintenance Team Leadership**

* Supervise, train, and support maintenance personnel in their daily responsibilities.
* Assign, prioritize, and monitor maintenance work orders and preventative maintenance tasks.
* Ensure maintenance requests are completed accurately, professionally, and within established timeframes.
* Provide technical guidance and assistance with troubleshooting and complex repairs.
* Monitor employee performance, productivity, and quality of work.
* Assist the General Manager with maintenance staffing needs, scheduling, training, and performance evaluations.
* Promote a positive, accountable, and team-oriented work environment.
* Ensure maintenance personnel follow proper safety procedures and property policies.

**Vendor & Contractor Management**

* Coordinate and oversee outside contractors, service providers, and maintenance vendors.
* Obtain quotes and assist with evaluating pricing, service proposals, and repair recommendations.
* Schedule and supervise vendor work to ensure projects are completed properly and with minimal disruption to residents.
* Monitor vendor performance and follow up on outstanding repairs or service issues.
* Assist in managing manufacturer warranties, equipment defects, and warranty-related repairs.
* Maintain accurate documentation of vendor work, service agreements, and completed projects.
* Work with the General Manager to identify cost-effective solutions without compromising quality or safety.

**Apartment Turnovers & Resident Service**

* Oversee apartment turnover procedures to ensure vacant units are prepared for new residents in a timely manner.
* Coordinate maintenance repairs, inspections, and make-ready schedules.
* Perform final inspections to ensure apartments meet the property's quality standards.
* Monitor resident maintenance requests and ensure timely resolution.
* Address escalated or recurring maintenance concerns and communicate appropriate solutions.
* Maintain a professional, courteous, and service-focused approach when interacting with residents.
* Work closely with the leasing and management teams to coordinate move-ins, move-outs, and apartment readiness.

**Budgeting, Inventory & Operational Planning**

* Assist the General Manager in developing and managing the maintenance and facilities operating budget.
* Monitor maintenance expenses, repair costs, supplies, and vendor services.
* Maintain appropriate inventory levels of maintenance materials, tools, equipment, and replacement parts.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce unnecessary expenses, and extend equipment life.
* Recommend capital improvements, major repairs, and equipment replacements based on property needs.
* Review maintenance-related expenses and provide input on purchasing decisions.
* Maintain organized records of work orders, inspections, equipment servicing, and maintenance projects.

**Safety, Compliance & Emergency Response**

* Ensure maintenance activities comply with applicable building codes, safety regulations, and property policies.
* Monitor building safety conditions and promptly address potential hazards.
* Coordinate emergency repairs and respond to urgent building maintenance issues.
* Maintain emergency response procedures for equipment failures, water leaks, power outages, and other property-related incidents.
* Participate in and coordinate after-hours emergency maintenance coverage.
* Work with the General Manager and appropriate vendors to resolve building emergencies and minimize disruption to residents.
* Ensure maintenance personnel receive appropriate safety training and use required protective equipment.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in multifamily residential, commercial building, or facilities maintenance.
* Previous supervisory or maintenance leadership experience preferred.
* Strong technical knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, mechanical systems, and general building maintenance.
* Experience overseeing preventative maintenance programs and building equipment.
* Familiarity with commercial building systems, including elevators, access controls, garage equipment, fire protection, and life-safety systems.
* EPA Section 608 certification preferred or required when applicable to assigned HVAC work.
* Strong organizational, leadership, troubleshooting, and decision-making skills.
* Experience coordinating vendors, contractors, and service agreements.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, respond to emergencies, and work independently.
* Strong communication skills and a commitment to resident satisfaction.
* Experience with maintenance management software and property management systems preferred.
* Ability to balance hands-on maintenance responsibilities with supervisory and administrative duties.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds independently, with assistance or equipment for heavier loads.
* Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, climb ladders, and perform hands-on maintenance work.
* Ability to inspect mechanical rooms, equipment areas, parking garages, and other building facilities.
* Ability to work indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Ability to respond to property emergencies outside normal business hours when necessary.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a Facilities Manager who takes ownership of the property and approaches maintenance with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset. The ideal candidate is someone who can lead a team while remaining actively involved in day-to-day operations, identify potential issues before they escalate, and maintain the high standards expected of a luxury residential community.

This individual should be dependable, organized, technically knowledgeable, and committed to maintaining a safe, attractive, and well-functioning property while providing exceptional service to our residents.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Facilities maintenance: 5 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

Title: Integrated Command & Control Center (ICCC) & Digital Twin (DT) Product Manager
Senior Program Manager
Description:
**About Citco**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services, delivering end-to-end solutions and service to clients across its global organization.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Senior Program Manager is accountable for the strategic direction, integrated planning and end-to-end delivery performance of AXI within the Investor Relations Value Stream. In addition to the official Senior Program Manager title, the role fulfils the Value Stream Delivery Lead responsibilities for Investor Relations, ensuring that agreed outcomes and priorities are translated into a coherent roadmap, single governed backlog and measurable delivery plan.
  
  
As a member of the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, the role partners with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to connect strategy with execution. The Senior Program Manager owns the overall flow and coordination of delivery, providing clear visibility of progress, capacity, cost, dependencies, risks, impediments and outcomes across AXI and related work.
  
  
As a Grade 4 leader, the Senior Program Manager operates with a high degree of autonomy and organizational influence. The role shapes delivery strategy, challenges constructively, resolves complex cross-functional constraints and represents the Value Stream in portfolio and executive forums. The position also includes formal line-management responsibility for staff within the Project Management Department, combining Value Stream delivery accountability with people leadership and capability development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI Delivery Leadership
  
  

* Fulfil the Delivery Lead role within the Investor Relations Value Stream Leadership Team, partnering with the Value Lead, Technology Lead and Operations Lead to turn agreed outcomes and priorities into executable delivery commitments.
* Own the integrated Investor Relations Value Stream roadmap, AXI program plan, single backlog and delivery performance, ensuring investment and execution remain aligned to agreed strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead a complex portfolio of projects and workstreams, balancing platform development, business change, operational readiness, releases and production priorities.
* Translate strategic direction and business cases into sequenced, achievable delivery plans with clear ownership, dependencies, milestones and success measures.
* Provide direction across cross-functional and globally distributed teams, creating alignment, pace, transparency, and accountability.
* Anticipate material delivery challenges and establish practical mitigation, recovery or escalation strategies before outcomes are affected.
* Act as the senior delivery authority for AXI and the Delivery Lead for the Investor Relations Value Stream, representing delivery in Value Stream, portfolio, executive and governance forums.
* Drive consistent delivery practices, delivery metrics and continuous improvement while allowing teams to apply fit-for-purpose Agile, Waterfall or hybrid methods.
* Coordinate cross-Value Stream demand and dependencies, negotiate sequencing with shared services and escalate priority decisions where demand exceeds available capacity.
* Manage Value Stream capacity, resource demand and allocation, ensuring commitments are realistic and delivery constraints are visible early.
* Lead quarterly planning, roadmap reviews, execution reviews and delivery governance across strategic change, client work, business requests, platform change and KTLO activity.
* Maintain one visible and prioritized backlog linking Value Stream outcomes and objectives to executable epics, stories and delivery commitments, with clear ownership and no orphaned work.
* Establish and facilitate the regular Investor Relations Value Stream leadership cadence, ensuring shared ownership across value, delivery, technology and operations.

**Value Stream Delivery, Flow and Ways of Working**
Integrated Planning, Governance and Financial Control
  
  

* Develop and maintain integrated Value Stream plans, roadmaps, budgets, forecasts, capacity and resource plans, and delivery scenarios across AXI and related Investor Relations outcomes.
* Establish proportionate governance across the full delivery lifecycle, including business case, scope, schedule, financials, quality, RAID, decisions, dependencies and benefits.
* Ensure program commitments are realistic and supported by sufficient capacity, funding, technical readiness and business ownership.
* Lead Value Stream prioritization and trade-off discussions where demand exceeds capacity or where scope, sequencing, cost, dependencies or risk require leadership or executive decision.
* Provide concise, evidence-based reporting on delivery confidence, financial position, outcomes and material constraints.
* Ensure program delivery complies with applicable Project Management Department, PMO, SDLC, risk and control requirements

**Technology Delivery and Release Oversight**

* Oversee delivery across the SDLC, ensuring requirements, design, engineering, testing, UAT, performance, release and production-readiness activities are integrated and governed.
* Partner with product, business and technology leadership to maintain alignment between business outcomes, platform priorities and technical execution.
* Coordinate cross-platform, cross-program and cross-Value Stream dependencies, ensuring demand, blockers and integration risks are visible, owned, sequenced and resolved.
* Ensure releases have clear acceptance criteria, quality evidence, operational readiness, communications, implementation and support arrangements.
* Own the health of the Value Stream delivery system, using flow, quality, capacity and financial data to identify bottlenecks, remove impediments, improve predictability and support continuous improvement.
* Promote fit-for-purpose use of Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches rather than applying a single methodology by default.

**Executive and Stakeholder Leadership**

* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors, business leaders, technology leaders, operations, control functions and external partners.
* Communicate complex delivery matters clearly and directly, adapting detail and recommendations to the audience.
* Present program status, risks, dependencies, investment choices and strategic recommendations to senior governance forums.
* Create a consistent program narrative across stakeholders and ensure decisions, commitments and accountabilities are understood and followed through.
* Challenge constructively where delivery confidence, scope, sequencing, ownership or expected value is unclear.
* Navigate competing priorities and organizational complexity while protecting agreed program outcomes.

**People Leadership and Project Management Capability**

* Provide formal line management for assigned staff within the Project Management Department, including regular one-to-ones, objective setting, performance and development conversations, and support for career growth.
* Set clear expectations for delivery quality, professional conduct, stakeholder management, governance and accountability.
* Allocate and balance work across direct reports, considering program priorities, individual capability, development needs and sustainable workload.
* Coach and mentor project and program management professionals, providing practical guidance on complex delivery situations and supporting sound judgement.
* Identify capability, capacity and succession needs within the team and contribute to recruitment, onboarding, talent development and retention.
* Promote consistent standards, reusable practices and knowledge-sharing across the Project Management Department and relevant communities of practice.
* Create an inclusive, collaborative environment where staff receive timely feedback, understand priorities and are supported to perform effectively.

**Measures of Success**

* Investor Relations Value Stream priorities and AXI investment are translated into one realistic, governed and outcome-focused roadmap and backlog.
* Program commitments are delivered with clear ownership, executive visibility and effective financial control.
* Material risks and dependencies are identified early, with timely decisions and credible mitigation or recovery plans.
* Business, product and technology stakeholders remain aligned on priorities, sequencing, delivery confidence and expected outcomes.
* Releases are delivered with appropriate quality, operational readiness and production support.
* Project Management Department staff have clear objectives, balanced assignments, regular feedback and meaningful development support.
* The Investor Relations Value Stream and AXI delivery teams demonstrate improving flow, predictability, transparency, collaboration and measurable value.

**Qualifications**
**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**
**Essential**

* Extensive experience leading large, complex and strategically important technology programs across multiple projects, workstreams and stakeholder groups.
* Demonstrated experience owning delivery execution, flow, planning, capacity, dependencies and governance within a Value Stream, product or comparable cross-functional operating model.
* Proven accountability for end-to-end program delivery, including strategy translation, integrated planning, governance, financial control, risk, dependency, quality and executive reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously, influence senior leaders and make sound decisions in ambiguous or high-pressure situations.
* Strong experience coordinating delivery across business, product, engineering, architecture, testing, operations and control functions.
* Deep understanding of SDLC and delivery methods, including Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches, with the judgement to tailor governance appropriately.
* Proven people-management experience, including objective setting, coaching, performance management, development planning, workload management and recruitment support.
* Experience leading and developing project or program management professionals across distributed teams.
* Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation and influencing capability.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, resource planning and investment trade-offs.
* Ability to connect program outputs to business outcomes, adoption and measurable value realization.

Desirable
  
  
**Personal Attributes**

* Strategic and outcome-focused, while remaining close enough to execution to intervene effectively.
* Creible and composed with senior stakeholders in complex or high-stakes situations.
* Decisive, pragmatic and willing to make delivery issues visible.
* Strong ownership mindset with high personal accountability.
* Inclusive people leader who sets clear expectations and invests in the development of others.
* Collaborative and able to lead through influence across organizational boundaries.
* Resilient, adaptable and committed to continuous improvement.

**Role Accountabilities**
The Senior Program Manager fulfils the Delivery Lead role for the Investor Relations Value Stream and owns delivery execution, flow, integrated planning, governance, financial control, dependencies and delivery performance for AXI. The Value Lead remains accountable for value, vision and priority decisions; the Technology Lead remains accountable for architecture, engineering quality and technical direction; and the Operations Lead remains accountable for operational input, readiness and adoption. The Senior Program Manager brings these perspectives together into one executable delivery system and is accountable for the effective line management and development of assigned Project Management Department staff.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
Your well-being is of paramount importance to us and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.

Description:
**Application Requirements**
----------------------------

Applications submitted with incomplete or missing education and/or work experience sections will be considered incomplete and will not be reviewed. These applicants will be disqualified from consideration. **The attachment of a resume to the application does not fulfill this requirement and will not prevent incomplete applications from being rejected.** **Education and work experience fields must be completed, regardless of the presence of an attached resume.**

  
  

Once the posting closes, all applications will be reviewed. The information provided on the application will be utilized to determine whether or not each applicant meets the Minimum Requirements for this position as noted in the Job Description. We encourage all applicants to provide a comprehensive, concise history of their education, certification, licensing, and employment history. Please read the Minimum Requirements thoroughly and then demonstrate that you meet these requirements on your application.

  
  

For questions regarding this posting, please contact Sherry Christman, Human Resources Analyst at schristman@norcopa.gov or 610-829-6382.

  
  

Equal Employment Opportunities – It is the policy of Northampton County to provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all persons regardless of race, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, sex, gender identity, gender expression, age, genetic information, disability, or any other status protected by the Pennsylvania Human Relations Act, Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, the Age Discrimination in Employment Act (ADEA), and the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and any other state, federal, or local law.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**GENERAL PURPOSE**
  
The 911 Training Manager position is responsible for providing initial and ongoing education for the public safety answering point (PSAP) for Northampton County.
  
  
**SUPERVISION RECEIVED**  
This position reports directly to the Deputy Director for 911 Operations.
  
  
**SUPERVISION EXERCISED**  
This position is responsible for supervision over the following classifications: Dispatch Shift Supervisor and Telecommunicator during training. May directly supervise Dispatch Shift Supervisor and Telecommunicator positions in conjunction with the Deputy Director for 911 Operations, Quality Assurance Manager for 911, and the Operations Manager for 911.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES OF THE POSITION**  
Trains and certifies new public safety answering point (PSAP) staff as call takers and Telecommunicators.
  
  
Provides training in the operation of Call Handling Equipment (CHE).
  
  
Provides training and certification for the Public Safety Suite products utilized by Northampton County.
  
  
Provides training with Computer Aided Dispatch (CAD) products to support the CAD system.
  
  
Provides training with PSAP equipment used for dispatching.
  
  
Oversees and manages the PSAP Certified Training Officer program.
  
  
Coordinates with local PSAPs to recruit Public Safety Telecommunicators (PSTs).
  
  
Prepares, maintains, and submits required PEMA reports for state mandated and continuing education courses, and prepares state audits.
  
  
Coordinates with management to establish a set of Quality Assurance/Quality Improvement (QAQI) metrics within Association of Public-Safety Communications Officials/National Emergency Number Association (APCO/NENA) American National Standards Institute (ANSI) standards.
  
  
Provides professional growth and continuing education courses for the PSAP.
  
Responsible for training new employees, conducting in-service training, and all required training certifications as assigned.
  
  
Responsible for tracking Certification Dates for all personnel.
  
  
Participates in the Quality Assurance Program, including but not limited to, issues that arise which may need to be addressed through individual training, or modifications to the training program as a whole.
  
  
Assists with all accreditation programs, including but not limited to, Commission on Accreditation of Law Enforcement Agencies (CALEA), and Fire/Police/EMS accreditation programs.
  
  
Assists the Deputy Director of 911 Operations with general budgetary matters, and the daily budgetary process including the preparation, maintenance, and execution of records on budget transfers, and other documentation.
  
  
Provides input and assistance to the Deputy Director of 911 Operations in project and policy development within its area of responsibility.
  
  
Responsible for compliance with National Crime Information Center (NCIC) and Commonwealth Law Enforcement Assistance Network (CLEAN) regulations and training.
  
  
Assists in the hiring and onboarding process for new employees.
  
  
Assists in the personnel evaluation program.
  
  
Assists with Call-Incident Reviews as assigned.
  
  
Assists with general office management.
  
  
Functions on floor as Dispatch Shift Supervisor and/or Telecommunicator, as needed.
  
  
As assigned, may serve in the absence of the Deputy Director for 911 Operations, Operations Manager for 911, and Quality Assurance Manager for 911.
  
  
Performs functions of the Operations Manager for 911 and Quality Assurance Manager, as assigned.
  
  
Responds for major public safety incidents on a 24-hour basis, and is on call for assigned shift, as needed.
  
  
Must be available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week for emergencies, as needed. Works non-business hours during drills, training, exercises, non-emergency events, and emergency events. Will periodically be required to be available during evening and night hours as emergency situations or management requirements dictate. Serves as Emergency Operations Center (EOC) Staff and may respond to incidents outside of the PSAP or EOC for planned and events and emergencies, as needed.
  
  
*\*An employee assigned to this title shall perform a majority, but may not perform all, of the duties listed in this job description. Conversely, minor level duties performed on the job may not be listed. The duties listed above are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related or a logical assignment to the position.*  
  
**REQUIRED MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**  
  
**EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE** – Completion of a high school or general equivalency diploma; **AND**
  
  
At least three (3) years of full time, professional work experience as a Telecommunicator and at least (2) years in a supervisory capacity such as Dispatch Shift Supervisor or Certified Training Officer (CTO); **AND**
  
  
Employee assigned to this title will be required to possess and maintain a valid and current motor vehicle operator’s license. Must have an acceptable driving record.
  
  
**CERTIFICATION/LICENSE** – Public Safety certifications preferred, but not required: Act 2, Act 120, National/State fire academy, EMT, Paramedic, Supervisor Pennsylvania Emergency Management Agency (PEMA) certification, Basic PEMA certification, Emergency Dispatch Quality Assurance (ED-Q) certification from the Internal Academy of Emergency Dispatch, and/or Association of Public-Safety Communications Officials (APCO) Instructor Certification.
  
  
**OTHER REQUIREMENTS** – Employee assigned to this title will periodically be required to be available during evening and night hours as emergency situations or management requirements dictate. Must be available to attend evening meetings of public safety agency organizations. May be required to travel to attend off-site meetings.
  
  
Must successfully complete criminal history investigation in accordance with departmental policy.
  
  
**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**  
Thorough knowledge of the standard operating procedures (SOP) and the goals and administrative policies for the 911 Operations Center.
  
  
Familiarity with the duties of all other dispatch and administrative staff positions at the Northampton County 911 Operations Center.
  
  
Ability to effectively communicate verbally and in writing. Clear speech with good (corrected) vision and hearing. Ability to discern color images on a video monitor.
  
  
Ability to read, write, speak, understand and communicate in English to perform the duties of this position. Bilingual capabilities are a plus.
  
  
Extensive knowledge of Public Safety Communications operations and procedures.
  
  
Knowledge of the specialized software used to answer and process emergency calls for service related to law enforcement, fire, and emergency medical operations.
  
  
Knowledge of supervisory practices including classroom management.
  
  
Effective time management skills, and ability to work independently.
  
  
Ability to assess training needs, organize course content, and coordinate courses at various locations involving multiple outside resources.
  
  
Possession and maintenance of requisite certifications related to public safety communications or education.
  
  
Ability to effectively instruct a group of students in a classroom setting of various sizes and demographics.
  
  
Ability to logically organize tasks and records.
  
  
Ability to maintain and track certification records for personnel.
  
  
Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time.
  
  
Ability to use normal office productivity software as well as any specialized software programs that may be in use.
  
  
Ability to work a flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends, to support the needs of the PSAPs. Ability to attend quarterly PEMA meetings, and 911 industry and professional conferences as needed.
  
  
Ability to network and plan with area emergency communication centers to provide cost effective training by coordinating training programs and resources.
  
  
**TOOLS AND EQUIPMENT**  
Telephone, personal computer (including word processing and spreadsheet software), calculator, writing implements, fax machine, copy machine, paper shredder, and communications equipment.
  
  
**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**  
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to walk, sit, talk or hear.
  
  
The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to twenty-five (25) pounds.
  
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
**WORK ENVIRONMENT**  
The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job
  
  
The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.
  
  
**SELECTION GUIDELINES**  
Formal application, rating of education and experience, interview, and reference check as well as job related tests may be required.

Title: Senior Manager - Planning & Operations
Description:
Transguard Group was established in 2001 and has diversified significantly, we lead in the fields of Cash Services, Security Services, Manpower Services, Facilities Management & Aviation. Transguard Group is the UAE’s most trusted business support and outsourcing provider and has a large, dynamic and culturally diverse workforce with 80,000 employees!

We are currently recruiting for a
**Senior Manager - Planning and Operations**
to join our Transport Team in our HQ, located in DAFZA, Dubai Airport Free Zone.

**Scope:**

Senior Manager-Planning and Operations is accountable for the end-to-end planning, optimisation, delivery and performance of Transguard’s workforce transportation network. The role owns the integrated transport planning and operational delivery cycle, ensuring transport demand forecasts are translated into effective fleet, driver and route plans and successfully executed through operational teams. The position is responsible for maximizing the utilization, efficiency and performance of a transport network comprising approximately 700 vehicles supporting more than 45,000 daily passenger movements. This includes accountability for fleet deployment, driver utilisation, route optimisation, service delivery, customer performance, transport costs and operational productivity. The role leads planning analysts, transport supervisors and operational teams to ensure alignment between workforce demand, transport capacity and customer requirements. Through the use of AI-enabled planning tools, transport management systems, telematics, GPS technology and business intelligence platforms, the role establishes a closed-loop performance management process that continuously measures actual performance against planned outcomes, drives operational improvements, improves planning accuracy and delivers sustainable efficiency gains across the transport function.

**Responsibilities:**

**Financial**

* Accountable for the optimization and performance of a transport operation with an annual operating budget.
* Own fleet utilization, resource allocation and service efficiency to maximise value from transport assets and workforce resources.
* Drive route optimization, vehicle productivity and driver utilisation initiatives to reduce operating costs whilst maintaining agreed service levels.
* Lead the identification and delivery of cost reduction, cost avoidance and operational efficiency opportunities across the transport network.
* Establish performance measures and reporting frameworks to monitor transport costs, utilization, productivity and return on fleet investment.

**Customer**

* Accountable for the delivery of safe, reliable and efficient transportation services supporting more than 45,000 daily passenger movements across Transguard operations.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external clients to ensure transport services align with operational requirements, workforce deployment plans and contractual commitments.
* Establish customer service standards, performance metrics and service level agreements, ensuring transport performance consistently meets agreed expectations.
* Lead the resolution of service issues, operational escalations and customer concerns, implementing corrective actions to improve service reliability and customer satisfaction.
* Utilize customer feedback, operational performance data and service reviews to identify improvement opportunities and enhance the overall customer experience.
* Provide regular performance reporting and operational insights to business leaders, creating transparency and confidence in transport service delivery.

**Process**

* Accountable for the end-to-end transport planning and operational delivery model across all workforce transportation activities.
* Own the integrated planning cycle, ensuring transport demand forecasts are translated into executable vehicle, route and driver deployment plans.
* Lead planning, scheduling and operational delivery teams to ensure transport services are delivered in accordance with business requirements and customer commitments.
* Establish and govern planning standards, operating procedures and performance frameworks across transport operations.
* Accountable for fleet utilization, route efficiency, driver productivity and service performance across the transport network.
* Direct the deployment of vehicles, drivers and operational resources to maximize service reliability and operational efficiency.
* Establish structured performance reviews comparing planned versus actual outcomes and ensure corrective actions are implemented to address variances.
* Lead transport capacity planning, network design and resource planning activities to support future business growth and changing demand.
* Own business continuity, operational resilience and transport risk management frameworks.
* Develop governance processes that create continuous improvement between planning assumptions, operational outcomes and future transport plans.

**Innovation**

* Support the transport planning and delivery transformation roadmap through the adoption of AI-enabled planning, predictive analytics, automation and optimization technologies.
* Establish a data-driven transport operating model using telematics, GPS intelligence and business intelligence platforms.
* Develop automated performance reporting that provides visibility of utilization, productivity, operational efficiency and customer service outcomes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance planning accuracy, improve operational performance and optimize asset utilization.
* Identify emerging transport technologies and support the development of business cases that improve efficiency, sustainability and customer experience.
* Create a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence by embedding performance feedback loops between planning and delivery teams.

**Selection Criteria:**

* Minimum 8-10 years' experience in large-scale transport, logistics, fleet or workforce mobility operations.
* Proven experience leading both transport planning and operational delivery functions within a complex, high-volume operational environment.
* Demonstrated experience managing transport management systems, telematics platforms, GPS technologies and business intelligence solutions.
* Strong track record in fleet optimization, route scheduling, capacity planning and operational productivity improvement.
* Experience leading large multidisciplinary teams and delivering measurable operational performance improvements.
* Strong analytical, commercial and data-driven decision-making capability.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI and transport planning software.

Title: QNB3670 - Manager Security Technologies Services (Qatarization)
Description:
**About QNB**
Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
  
  
QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
  
  
QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard & Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3) and Fitch (A+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
  
  
Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
  
  
QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The incumbent will be primarily responsible in providing support of the Information Security solutions. This includes provide first and second line support and maintain key technology solutions designed to protect the firm from cyber security attacks. The incumbent will be the focal point for end user escalations for security technology issues they may be experiencing.
  
  
Main Responsibilities
  
  

* Shareholder & Financial: - Promote cost consciousness and efficiency and enhance productivity, to minimise cost, avoid waste, and optimise benefits for the bank. - Implements KPI’s and best practices for Security Technologies Services - Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent. - Support to maintain KPI’s and best practices for AVP – Cyber Security Technologies & Services
* Customer (Internal & External): - Provide 1st level support to key technical security solutions in line with business strategies and objectives of the group - Support operational process, procedures and guidelines, aligned to good practise for service management, problem and incident management, change management and configuration management. - Support end users with installation and troubleshooting of GIS provided and supported security products on their devices. - Review of IT and business requests for change requests to security controls (for example: firewall change reviews) - To assist customers in all their queries on Bank’s product and seek solution to their requests. - Maintain activities in accordance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with internal departments/units to achieve improvements in turn-around time. - Build and maintain strong/effective relationships with related departments/units to achieve the Group’s objectives. - Provide timely/accurate data to external/internal Auditors, Compliance, Financial Control and Risk when required.
* Internal (Processes, Products, Regulatory): - Support the design and implementation of the QNB's information security program. - Develop, implement and administer technical security standards, as well as a suite of security services and tools to address and mitigate security risk. - Examine impacts of new technologies on the QNB's overall information security profile. - Establish processes to review implementation of new technologies to ensure security compliance. - Responsible to ensuring that any audit issues or identified regulatory gaps are addressed timely.
* Learning & Knowledge: - Possess an understanding of business processes and controls in all related operational areas. - Must have an expert understanding of information security issues, best practices, and a working knowledge of IT systems. - Create education and training program within the team and advise operating units at all levels on security issues, best practices, and vulnerabilities. - Proactively identify areas for professional development of self and undertake development activities. - Seek out opportunities to remain current with all developments in professional field. - Ensure speedy resolution of unresolved grievances or conflicts within the team members. E. Legal, Regulatory, and Risk Framework Responsibilities: - Comply with all applicable legal, regulatory and internal compliance requirements including, but not limited to, Group Compliance Policies and Procedures (AML & CTF, Sanctions Policy, Data Protection Policy, Fraud Control Policy, Whistle Blowing Policy, Conflict of Interest and Insider Dealing Policy). - Understand and effectively perform your role under the Three Lines of Defence principle to identify measure, monitor, manage and report risks.
* Other: - Ensure high standards of data protection and confidentiality to safeguard commercially sensitive information. - Maintaining utmost confidentiality concerning customer and internal bank information obtained during the course of business and provide such information on a need to know basis only to Senior Management of QNB, Audit and Compliance functions, and relevant Regulators. - Maintain high professional standards to uphold QNB's reputation and to strengthen its market leadership position. - All other ad hoc duties/activities related to QNB that management might request from time to time.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree preferably in computer science, computer engineering or related subjects.
* At least 6 years of relevant experience, preferably within a highly rated international bank or large corporate in an information security engineering capacity.
* Professional certification such as CISSP is mandatory
* Security engineering certifications and qualifications in Microsoft operating systems (such as MCSA, MCSE, et al) or Linux (such as RHCP, et al) are mandatory

Note: you will be required to attach the following:
  
  

* Resume/CV
* Copy of Passport or QID
* Copy of Education Certificate
* Copy of Birth Certificate

Title: Head of Operations
Description:
**Rize**
is a groundbreaking rent-now-pay-later platform reshaping the rental landscape in Saudi Arabia. We're dedicated to making rentals more accessible and affordable, enabling tenants to manage their finances with ease and landlords to secure their income effortlessly. We're on a mission to revolutionize the rental industry, breaking down barriers and creating opportunities for all. We're a team of innovators, thinkers, and problem-solvers, committed to creating a positive impact and driving change in the market.
  
  
**Our Team**
We love working together, being creative, and doing things differently! Our team is made up of people with different nationalities. We work from a cozy office in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. And hey, we're not just smart, we're really good at coming up with new ideas.
  
  
**Our core values & Principles**

* Innovation – We’re a technology-driven team with the purpose of uplifting the real estate sector. We are the leaders of the industry in innovation.
* Customer Centricity – We put the customer at the core of every decision and action.
* Adaptability - Being able to adapt quickly to changing market conditions and customer needs.
* Empowerment & Collaboration – Our team is the most valuable aspect of the company; We respect all ideas, our team enjoys authority, autonomy, and collaboration.
* Ethical Excellence - We perform within the highest ethical standard.

**Job Summary**
You will build a single Operations department that owns everything after the sale: checking, contracting, paying the landlord, collecting, serving and renewing. Your mission is to build the engine that carries Rize to several times today’s volume, with faster turnaround, higher accuracy and less manual work.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Bring Credit Operations, Contracting and Fulfilment, Collections and Payments, and Customer Experience and Renewals under one structure with clear roles, service levels and handovers to Risk, Sales and Finance.
* Cut the time from approval to signed contract, Ejar registration and landlord payout, and run the shifts and payout runs that support same-day payment.
* Act as the business owner of operations automation with Product and Tech: decide what the system should do versus people, and raise output per employee instead of adding headcount with volume.
* Ensure every case is tracked end to end with recorded justification, and that Operations, Risk and Finance work from one accurate source, ready for lender and external audits.
* Execute the collections strategy set by Risk, owning on-time collections, cure rate, recovery and cost to collect.
* Make customer experience and renewals a strength for tenants, landlords and brokers.
* Write and maintain the operations manual, service levels and controls.
* Plan capacity ahead of volume and set up operations for new cities and products.
* Develop team leads into managers, with clear job levels and career paths.
* Report regularly to the leadership team on speed, quality, cost and customer results.

**You're a perfect match if you have**

* 10+ years in operations, including 4+ years leading multi-unit operations at a consumer finance company, BNPL player, fintech lender, bank retail operations or high-volume marketplace.
* Experience running processing, collections and customer service at volume, and taking an operation through several times growth.
* Track record of process redesign and automation with product and tech teams, with measurable results on cycle time, cost and quality.
* Comfort with lender, auditor and regulator expectations: controls, separation of duties, service levels, case documentation.
* Experience managing managers and building team-lead layers and career ladders.
* Fluent Arabic and professional English.

**Strong advantage:**
knowledge of Saudi rental and government platforms (Ejar, Najiz, the real estate registry).
  
  
**Benefits**
**What do we offer?**

* Competitive salary - Receive a competitive salary package in USD or SAR, reflecting your skills and contributions in our industry.
* Diverse International team - Join a diverse international team where different perspectives and backgrounds enrich our collaborative culture.
* Innovation - Shape the future of Proptech with your groundbreaking ideas and technological prowess.
* Direct Impact - See your ideas come to life and make tangible changes in an industry ripe for revolution.
* Fast-paced Learning - Grow personally and professionally every day with opportunities to master new skills in our dynamic start-up environment.
* Creative Freedom - Take the reins, innovate, and push boundaries with the freedom to experiment, learn, and grow at Rize.
* Close-knit Community - Join a collaborative, supportive team where your voice matters and your contributions are recognized and celebrated.
